entries.label: Average Assets ($000)
entries.definition: The year-to-date cumulative sum of the quarterly average consolidated assets divided by the number of calendar quarters to date (four-point average).

entries.label: Net Income ($000)
entries.definition: The amount of net income.

entries.label: Number of BHCs in Peer Group
entries.definition: The total number of holding companies in the peer group to which an individual holding company belongs. (See Peer Groups in section 2.)

entries.label: Net Interest Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Net interest income on a taxable equivalent basis divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Non-Interest Income
entries.definition: Total non-interest income divided by average assets.

entries.label: Overhead Expense
entries.definition: The sum of salaries and employee benefits, expense on premises and fixed assets (net of rental income), amortization expense of intangible assets, and other non-interest expenses (i.e., total non-interest expense) divided by average assets.

entries.label: Provision for Credit Losses
entries.definition: The provision for credit losses divided by average assets. Prior to the holding company’s adoption of ASU 2016-13, the provision for loan and lease losses divided by average assets. 14 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Securities Gains (Losses)
entries.definition: The difference between the sales price and amortized cost of securities that are classified as held-to-maturity or available-for-sale divided by average assets. Included in realized losses are write-downs of the cost basis resulting from other-than-temporary impairments.

entries.label: Other Tax Equivalent Adjustments
entries.definition: Other tax equivalent adjustments, excluding the tax benefit on tax-exempt interest income, divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Pretax Net Operating Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Income or loss before income taxes, extraordinary items, and other adjustments on a taxable equivalent basis divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Net Operating Income
entries.definition: Income after applicable income taxes and minority interest but before extraordinary items and other adjustments divided by average assets.

entries.label: Net Income
entries.definition: The amount of net income after applicable taxes, minority interest, extraordinary items, and adjustments divided by average assets.

entries.label: Net Income (Subchapter S Adjusted)
entries.definition: The amount of net income, adjusted downward by an assumed federal tax rate of 21 percent (35 percent prior to March 31, 2018), divided by average assets. This ratio is only computed for holding companies that have elected Subchapter S tax status.

entries.label: Interest Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Total interest income on a taxable equivalent basis divided by average earning assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Interest Expense
entries.definition: Total interest expense divided by average earning assets.

entries.label: Net Interest Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Net interest income on a taxable equivalent basis divided by average earning assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Losses, Allowance, and Past Due and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases
Net Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Average Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Gross losses on loans and leases minus recoveries divided by (four-point) average loans and leases, net of unearned income. Prior to March 31, 2001, net loan and lease losses include net chargeoffs to the allocated transfer risk reserve.

entries.label: Earnings Coverage of Net Credit Losses on Loans and Leases (X)
entries.definition: Income before taxes, minority interest, and extraordinary items plus the provision for losses on loans and leases (including the provision for allocated transfer risk prior to March 31, 2001) divided by net credit losses on loans and leases. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Total Loans and Leases Not Held For Sale
entries.basis: Total Loans and Leases Not Held For Sale
entries.definition: Allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by total loans and leases not held for sale.

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Total Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by total loans and leases, net of unearned income. Prior to March 31, 2001, the allowance for loan and lease losses includes the allocated transfer risk reserve.

entries.label: Nonaccrual Loans and Leases Plus Other Real Estate Owned / Total Loans and Leases Plus Other Real Estate Owned
entries.basis: Total Loans and Leases Plus Other Real Estate Owned
entries.definition: The sum of loans and leases in nonaccrual status plus other real estate owned divided by the sum of loans and leases (net of unearned income) plus other real estate owned.

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due Loans and Leases / Total Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and leases past due 30 to 89 days divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income. Confidential prior to March 31, 2001.

entries.label: Net Noncore Funding Dependence
entries.definition: The difference between noncore funding and short-term investments divided by long-term assets. “Noncore funding” is the sum of time deposits with balances of $250,000 or more, deposits in foreign offices and Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase, commercial paper, other borrowings (including mortgage indebtedness and obligations under capitalized leases), and brokered deposits less than $250,000. Prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000. “Short-term investments” is defined as the sum of interest-bearing bank balances, federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell, and debt securities with a remaining maturity of one year or less. Prior to March 31, 2001, short-term investments include acceptances of other banks. “Long-term assets” is comprised of loans and leases (net of unearned income and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases), debt securities with a remaining maturity of over one year, equity securities, and other real estate owned. From March 2001 to March 2009, instead of other real estate owned, other real estate acquired in satisfaction of debts previously contracted was included. Prior to March 31, 2001, acceptances of other banks were deducted from long-term assets.

entries.label: Net Short-Term Noncore Funding Dependence
entries.definition: The difference between short-term noncore funding and short-term investments divided by long-term assets. “Short-term noncore funding” is the sum of commercial paper, federal funds purchased, and securities sold under agreements to repurchase, and the following liability items with a remaining maturity of one year or less: 16 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report time deposits with balances of $250,000 or more, deposits in foreign offices and Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, other borrowings (including mortgage indebtedness and obligations under capitalized leases), and brokered deposits less than $250,000. Prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000. (See the definitions of short-term investments and long-term assets above.)

entries.label: Net Loans and Leases / Total Assets
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables, net of unearned income and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases, divided by total assets.

entries.label: Tier 1 Leverage Ratio
entries.definition: Tier 1 Leverage ratio reported on FR Y-9C Schedule HC-R. (See the definition of the tier 1 capital components in the Regulatory Capital Components and Ratios page description in this section.)

entries.label: Holding Company Equity Capital / Total Assets
entries.definition: Holding company equity capital divided by total assets.

entries.label: Total Equity Capital (Including Minority Interest) / Total Assets
entries.definition: Total equity capital including noncontrolling (minority) interests in consolidated subsidiaries divided by total assets.

entries.label: Common Equity Tier 1 Capital / Total Risk-Weighted Assets
entries.definition: Common equity tier 1 capital divided by total risk-weighted assets. This ratio is not calculated in quarters for which the holding company has a community bank leverage ratio (CBLR) framework election in effect.

entries.label: Net Loans and Leases / Equity Capital (X)
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables, net of unearned income and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases, divided by total equity capital. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and, therefore, is not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Cash Dividends / Net Income
entries.definition: Total cash dividends declared divided by net income.

entries.label: Cash Dividends / Net Income (Subchapter S Adjusted)
entries.definition: Total cash dividends declared adjusted downward by an assumed federal tax rate of 21 percent, divided by net income, adjusted downward by an assumed federal tax rate of 21 percent. This ratio is computed only for holding companies that have elected Subchapter S tax status. Prior to March 31, 2018, the assumed federal tax rate is 35 percent. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Short-Term Debt / Equity Capital
entries.definition: Borrowings with a remaining maturity of one year or less, including commercial paper, divided by total equity capital.

entries.label: Long-Term Debt / Equity Capital
entries.definition: The sum of other borrowings with a remaining maturity of greater than one year, and subordinated notes and debentures divided by total equity capital. Prior to March 2001, long-term debt is calculated as the sum of other borrowings with a remaining maturity of greater than one year, subordinated notes and debentures, equity contract notes, and equity commitment notes.

entries.label: Equity Investment in Subsidiaries / Equity Capital
entries.definition: Equity investment in bank subsidiaries and associated banks, in nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies, and in subsidiary holding companies divided by total equity capital.

entries.label: Cash Flow from Operations Plus Noncash Items Plus Operating Expense / Operating Expense Plus Dividends

entries.label: Interest and Fees on Loans
entries.definition: Interest and yield-related fee income on domestic and foreign loans.

entries.label: Income from Lease Financing Receivables
entries.definition: Income from lease financing receivables.

entries.label: Fully Taxable Income on Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The sum of interest and fee income on domestic and foreign loans (excluding interest on tax-exempt obligations of states and political subdivisions in the U.S.) and taxable lease financing receivables.

entries.label: Tax-exempt Income on Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Tax-exempt interest income on obligations of states and political subdivisions in the U.S. and lease financing receivables.

entries.label: Estimated Tax Benefit on Income on Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The estimated tax benefit attributable to tax-exempt loan and lease income. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Income on Loans and Leases (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: The sum of taxable and tax-exempt income on loans and lease financing receivables and the estimated tax benefit on the tax-exempt income on loans and leases. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Investment Interest Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Interest and dividend income on securities plus the estimated tax benefit on tax-exempt securities. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Interest on Balances Due from Depository Institutions
entries.definition: Interest income on balances due from depository institutions.

entries.label: Interest Income on Other Earning Assets
entries.definition: The sum of interest income on federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell, interest income on assets held in trading accounts, and other interest income.

entries.label: Total Interest Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Total interest income plus the tax equivalent adjustment. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.) 20 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Interest on Time Deposits of $250 Thousand or More
entries.definition: Interest expense on time deposits of $250,000 or more in domestic offices.

entries.label: Interest on Time Deposits below $250 Thousand
entries.definition: Interest expense on time deposits of less than $250,000 in domestic offices.

entries.label: Interest on Foreign Office Deposits
entries.definition: Interest expense on deposits in foreign offices, Edge and Agreement subsidiaries, and International Banking Facilities.

entries.label: Interest on Other Deposits
entries.definition: Interest expense on other domestic deposits.

entries.label: Interest on Other Borrowings and Trading Liabilities
entries.definition: Interest expenses on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase, trading liabilities, and other interest expense.

entries.label: Interest on Subordinated Debt and Mandatory Convertible Securities
entries.definition: Interest expenses on subordinated notes and debentures and on mandatory convertible securities (equity contract notes and equity commitment notes).

entries.label: Total Interest Expense
entries.definition: Interest expenses on time and other deposits in domestic offices, deposits in foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries and International Banking Facilities, federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase, trading liabilities, other borrowed funds (including mortgage indebtedness and obligations under capitalized leases), subordinated notes and debentures, mandatory convertible securities, and other interest expense.

entries.label: Net Interest Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Net interest income plus the tax equivalent adjustment. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Non-Interest Income
entries.definition: Total non-interest income.

entries.label: Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: The sum of net interest income on a taxable equivalent basis and non-interest income. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Overhead Expense
entries.definition: Total non-interest expense including salaries and employee benefits, expense on premises and fixed assets (net of rental income), amortization expense of intangible assets, and other non-interest expense.

entries.label: Provision for Credit Losses
entries.definition: The year-to-date provision for credit losses. Prior to the holding company’s adoption of ASU 2016-13, the provision for loan and lease losses.

entries.label: Securities Gains (Losses)
entries.definition: The sum of realized gains (losses) on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity securities.

entries.label: Other Tax Equivalent Adjustments
entries.definition: Other tax equivalent adjustments, excluding the tax benefit on tax-exempt interest income. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Pretax Net Operating Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Income before income taxes, extraordinary items, and other adjustments on a taxable equivalent basis. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Applicable Income Taxes
entries.definition: The total estimated federal, state, local, and foreign income tax expense.

entries.label: Tax Equivalent Adjustments
entries.definition: The total taxable equivalent adjustment which results from subtracting the reported pretax income from the fully taxable equivalent pretax income. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Applicable Income Taxes (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: The sum of applicable income taxes and total taxable equivalent adjustments. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Minority Interest
entries.definition: Net income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling (minority) interests.

entries.label: Net Income before Discontinued Operations, Net of Minority Interest
entries.definition: Net income before discontinued operations and other adjustments.

entries.label: Net Discontinued Operations
entries.definition: Discontinued operations, net of applicable income tax.

entries.label: Net Income Attributable to Holding Company
entries.definition: The amount of net income (loss) attributable to the holding company.

entries.label: Net Income (Loss)—Holding Company and Noncontrolling (Minority) Interest
entries.definition: Net income (loss) attributable to the holding company and noncontrolling (minority) interest.

entries.label: Investment Securities Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Interest income on investment securities plus the estimated tax benefit on interest income from tax-exempt securities. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: U.S. Treasury and Agency Securities (Excluding Mortgage-Backed Securities)
entries.definition: Interest income on U.S. Treasury securities and U.S. government agency obligations, excluding mortgage-backed securities.

entries.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities
entries.definition: Interest income on mortgage-backed securities.

entries.label: All Other Securities
entries.definition: Interest income on all other debt securities and equity securities that are reported on Schedule HC-B as securities issued by states and political subdivisions in the U.S., asset-backed securities, other debt securities, and investments in mutual funds and other equity securities with readily determinable fair values. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Cash Dividends Declared
entries.definition: Cash dividends declared on common stock and preferred stock during the calendar year-to-date, including dividends not payable until after the report date. 22 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Common
entries.definition: Cash dividends declared on common stock during the calendar year-to-date, including dividends not payable until after the report date.

entries.label: Preferred
entries.definition: Cash dividends declared on preferred stock (including limited-life preferred stock) during the calendar year-to-date, including dividends not payable until after the report date. section: Relative Income Statement and Margin Analysis

entries.label: Interest Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Total interest income on a tax equivalent basis divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Interest Expense
entries.definition: Total interest expense divided by average assets.

entries.label: Net Interest Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Net interest income on a tax equivalent basis divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Non-Interest Income
entries.definition: Non-interest income divided by average assets.

entries.label: Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: The sum of net interest income on a tax equivalent basis and non-interest income divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Overhead Expense
entries.definition: The sum of salaries and employee benefits, expense on premises and fixed assets, amortization expense of intangible assets, and other non-interest expense divided by average assets.

entries.label: Provision for Credit Losses
entries.definition: Provision for credit losses divided by average assets. Prior to the holding company’s adoption of ASU 2016-13, the provision for loan and lease losses divided by average assets.

entries.label: Realized Gains (Losses) on Held-to-Maturity Securities
entries.definition: The difference between the sales price and the amortized cost that is realized from the sale, exchange, redemption, or retirement of securities that are classified as held-to-maturity divided by average assets.

entries.label: Realized Gains (Losses) on Available-for-Sale Securities
entries.definition: The difference between the sales price and the amortized cost that is realized from the sale, exchange, redemption, or retirement of securities that are classified as available-for-sale divided by average assets.

entries.label: Other Tax Equivalent Adjustments
entries.definition: Other tax adjustments, excluding the tax benefit on tax-exempt income, divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Pretax Net Operating Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Income or loss before income taxes, extraordinary items, and other adjustments on a tax equivalent basis divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.) 26 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Applicable Income Taxes (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: The sum of applicable income taxes, the tax benefit on tax-exempt income, and other tax equivalent adjustments divided by average assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Minority Interest
entries.definition: Minority interest in the income of consolidated subsidiaries divided by average assets.

entries.label: Net Operating Income
entries.definition: Income or loss before extraordinary items and other adjustments divided by average assets.

entries.label: Net Extraordinary Items
entries.definition: Extraordinary items net of applicable income taxes and other adjustments divided by average assets.

entries.label: Net Income
entries.definition: Net income divided by average assets.

entries.label: Net Income (Last Four Quarters)
entries.basis: Percent of Average Assets, Last Four Quarters
entries.definition: The cumulative amount of net income reported for the latest four quarters divided by the mean of quarterly average assets reported in Schedule HC-K for those four quarters.

entries.label: Net Income (Loss)—Holding Company and Noncontrolling (Minority) Interests
entries.definition: Net income (loss) attributable to the holding company and noncontrolling (minority) interests divided by average assets.

entries.label: Average Earning Assets / Average Assets
entries.definition: Average earning assets divided by average assets.

entries.label: Average Interest-Bearing Funds / Average Assets
entries.definition: Average interest-bearing funds divided by average assets.

entries.label: Interest Income (Tax Equivalent) / Average Earning Assets
entries.definition: Total interest income on a tax equivalent basis divided by average earning assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Interest Expense / Average Earning Assets
entries.definition: Total interest expense divided by average earning assets.

entries.label: Net Interest Income (Tax Equivalent) / Average Earning Assets
entries.definition: Net interest income on a tax equivalent basis divided by average earning assets. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Total Loans and Leases (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Interest and fee income on loans and lease financing receivables on a tax equivalent basis divided by average loans and leases. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Interest-Bearing Bank Balances
entries.definition: Interest income on balances due from depository institutions divided by the five-point average of interest-bearing bank balances.

entries.label: Federal Funds Sold and Reverse Repos
entries.definition: Interest income on federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell divided by the fourpoint average balance of federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell.

entries.label: Trading Assets
entries.definition: Interest income from assets held in trading accounts divided by the five-point average of trading assets. The interest income from trading assets excludes gains or losses on assets held in trading accounts.

entries.label: Total Earning Assets
entries.definition: Total interest income divided by average earning assets.

entries.label: Investment Securities (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Interest income on total investment securities plus the estimated tax benefit on interest income from tax-exempt securities divided by the four-point average of the amortized cost of all investment securities. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: U.S. Treasury and Agency Securities (Excluding Mortgage-Backed Securities)
entries.definition: Income on U.S. Treasury securities and obligations of U.S. government agencies and corporations (excluding mortgage-backed securities) divided by the four-point average of the amortized cost of U.S. Treasury securities and U.S. government obligations (excluding mortgage-backed securities).

entries.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities
entries.definition: Income on mortgage-backed securities divided by the four-point average of the amortized cost of mortgage-backed securities.

entries.label: All Other Securities
entries.definition: Interest income on all other debt securities and equity securities that are reported on Schedule HC-B as securities issued by states and political subdivisions in the U.S., asset-backed securities, other debt securities, and invest28 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report ments in mutual funds and other equity securities with readily determinable fair values divided by the four-point average of the amortized cost of all other securities. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Interest-Bearing Deposits
entries.definition: Interest paid on all interest-bearing deposits divided by the four-point average balance of domestic and foreign interest-bearing deposits.

entries.label: Time Deposits of $250 Thousand or More
entries.definition: Interest paid on time deposits of $250,000 or more in domestic offices divided by the five-point average balance of time deposits of $250,000 or more in domestic offices.

entries.label: Time Deposits below $250 Thousand
entries.definition: Interest paid on time deposits less than $250,000 in domestic offices divided by the five-point average balance of time deposits below $250,000 in domestic offices.

entries.label: Other Domestic Deposits
entries.definition: Interest paid on other domestic deposits divided by the five-point average balance of the sum of negotiable orders of withdrawal (i.e., NOW accounts), ATS accounts (accounts subject to automatic transfer from savings accounts), other transaction accounts, money market deposit accounts, and other savings accounts in domestic offices.

entries.label: Foreign Deposits
entries.definition: Interest paid on deposits in foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, and International Banking Facilities divided by the four-point average balance of foreign interest-bearing deposits.

entries.label: Federal Funds Purchased and Repos
entries.definition: The expense on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase divided by the four-point average balances of federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

entries.label: Other Borrowed Funds and Trading Liabilities
entries.definition: Interest expense on trading liabilities and other borrowed money, excluding subordinated notes and debentures, divided by the four-point average balance of other borrowed funds trading liabilities.

entries.label: Total Non-Interest Income
entries.definition: The sum of fiduciary activities income; service charges on domestic deposit accounts; trading revenue; fees and commissions from securities brokerage; investment banking, advisory, and underwriting fees and commission; fees and commissions from annuity sales; underwriting income from insurance and reinsurance activities; income from other insurance activities; venture capital revenue; net servicing fees; net securitization income; net gains (losses) on the sales of loans, OREO, and other assets (excluding securities); and other non-interest income.

entries.label: Fiduciary Activities Income
entries.definition: Income derived from services rendered by trust departments of banking subsidiaries or a subsidiary acting in any fiduciary capacity.

entries.label: Service Charges on Domestic Deposit Accounts—Domestic
entries.definition: Service charges on deposit accounts.

entries.label: Trading Revenue
entries.definition: The net gain or loss recognized from trading cash instruments and derivative contracts (including commodity contracts). It results from revaluation adjustments (as a result of periodic marking to market) to the carrying value of trading assets and liabilities, as well as interest rate, foreign exchange, equity derivative, and commodity and other contracts.

entries.label: Investment Banking Fees and Commissions
entries.definition: The sum of fees and commissions from securities brokerage; investment banking, advisory, and underwriting fees and commissions; and fees and commissions from annuity sales.

entries.label: Insurance Activities Revenue
entries.definition: The amount of insurance and reinsurance underwriting income plus other insurance and reinsurance activities income.

entries.label: Venture Capital Revenue
entries.definition: This item includes market value adjustments, interest, dividends, gains, and losses (including impairment losses) on venture capital investments (loans and securities). It also includes any fee income from venture capital activities not reported in other line items of Schedule HI of the FR Y-9C. In addition, it includes the holding company’s proportionate share of income or loss in unconsolidated subsidiaries, associated companies, and joint ventures principally engaged in venture capital activities.

entries.label: Net Servicing Fees
entries.definition: Income from servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by third parties.

entries.label: Net Securitization Income
entries.definition: Net gains (losses) on assets sold in securitization transactions.

entries.label: Net Gains (Losses) on Sales of Loans, OREO, and Other Assets (Excluding Securities)
entries.definition: The amount of net gains and losses on sales and other disposals of loans and leases, other real estate owned, and other assets (excluding securities).

entries.label: Other Non-Interest Income
entries.definition: All other operating income of the consolidated holding company.

entries.label: Total Overhead Expenses
entries.definition: The sum of salaries and employee benefits, expense on premises and fixed assets (net of rental income), amortization expense of intangible assets, and other non-interest expense.

entries.label: Personnel Expense
entries.definition: Salaries and benefits expenses of all officers and employees of the holding company and consolidated subsidiaries.

entries.label: Net Occupancy Expense
entries.definition: Non-interest expense related to the use of premises, equipment, and furniture and fixtures, net of rental income.

entries.label: Goodwill Impairment
entries.definition: Impairment losses on goodwill.

entries.label: Amortization Expense and Impairment Losses (other)
entries.definition: Amortization expense and impairment losses on other intangible assets.

entries.label: Other Operating Expenses
entries.definition: All other operating expenses of the consolidated holding company.

entries.label: Fee Income on Mutual Funds and Annuities
entries.definition: Income from the sale and servicing of mutual funds and annuities (in domestic offices).

entries.label: Assets Under Management in Proprietary Mutual Funds and Annuities
entries.definition: The amount of assets held by mutual funds and annuities for which the holding company or a subsidiary of the holding company acts as investment adviser.

entries.label: Number of Equivalent Employees
entries.definition: The number of full-time equivalent employees on the payroll of the consolidated holding company.

entries.label: Average Personnel Expense Per Employee
entries.definition: Salaries and employee benefits divided by the number of full-time equivalent employees (expressed in thousands of dollars).

entries.label: Average Assets Per Employee
entries.definition: Average assets divided by the number of full-time equivalent employees, expressed in thousands of dollars. (See Average Balances in section 2.)

entries.label: Mutual Fund Fee Income / Non-Interest Income
entries.definition: The amount of fee income from the sale and servicing of mutual funds and annuities in domestic offices divided by total non-interest income. 32 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Overhead Expense / Net Interest Income Plus Non-Interest Income
entries.basis: Net Interest Income Plus Non-Interest Income
entries.definition: The sum of salaries and employee benefits, expense on premises and fixed assets (net of rental income), goodwill impairment losses, amortization expense and impairment losses for other intangible assets, and other noninterest expense divided by the sum of net interest income and non-interest income.

entries.label: Total Overhead Expense
entries.definition: The sum of salaries and employee benefits, expense on premises and fixed assets (net of rental income), goodwill impairment losses, amortization expense and impairment losses for other intangible assets, and other noninterest expense divided by average assets.

entries.label: Personnel Expense
entries.definition: Salaries and employee benefits divided by average assets.

entries.label: Net Occupancy Expense
entries.definition: Expense on premises and fixed assets divided by average assets.

entries.label: Other Operating Expenses
entries.definition: Other non-interest expense, including goodwill impairment losses, amortization expense and impairment losses for other intangible assets, divided by average assets.

entries.label: Overhead Less Non-Interest Income
entries.definition: The difference between total overhead expense and non-interest income divided by average assets.

entries.label: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent)
Total Overhead Expense
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: The sum of salaries and employee benefits, expense on premises and fixed assets (net of rental income), goodwill impairment losses, amortization expense and impairment losses for other intangible assets, and other noninterest expense divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Personnel Expense
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Salaries and employee benefits divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Net Occupancy Expense
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Expense on premises and fixed assets divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Other Operating Expenses
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Other non-interest expense, including goodwill impairment losses, amortization expense and impairment losses for other intangible assets, divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Total Non-Interest Income
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Income derived from fiduciary activities; service charges on domestic deposit accounts; trading revenue; fees and commissions from securities brokerage; investment banking, advisory, and underwriting fees and commissions; fees and commissions from annuity sales; underwriting income from insurance and reinsurance activities; income from other insurance activities; venture capital revenue; net servicing fees; net securitization income; net gains (losses) on the sales of loans, OREO, and other assets (excluding securities); and other sources of non-interest revenue divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Fiduciary Activities Income
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Fiduciary activities income divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Service Charges on Domestic Deposit Accounts
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Service charges on domestic deposit accounts divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Trading Revenue
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: The net gain or loss recognized from trading cash instruments and derivative contracts (including commodity contracts) divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Investment Banking Fees and Commissions
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: The sum of fees and commissions from securities brokerage; investment banking, advisory, and underwriting fees and commissions; and fees and commissions from annuity sales divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Insurance Activities Revenue
entries.definition: The amount of insurance activities revenue divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Venture Capital Revenue
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Market value adjustments, interest, dividends, gains, losses (including impairment losses) on (and other fees from) venture capital investments (loans and securities) and the holding company’s proportionate share of income or loss in unconsolidated subsidiaries, associated companies, and joint ventures principally engaged in venture capital activities divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Net Servicing Fees
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Income from servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by others divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Net Securitization Income
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: Net gains (losses) on assets sold in securitization transactions divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Net Gains (Losses) on Sales of Loans, OREO, and Other Assets
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: The amount of net gains and losses on sales and other disposals of loans and leases, other real estate owned, and other assets (excluding securities) divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis. 34 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Other Non-Interest Income
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: All other operating income of the holding company divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Overhead Less Non-Interest Income
entries.basis: Percent of Adjusted Operating Income (Tax Equivalent
entries.definition: The difference between overhead expense and non-interest income divided by adjusted operating income on a tax equivalent basis.

entries.label: Applicable Income Taxes / Pretax Net Operating Income (Tax Equivalent)
entries.definition: Applicable income taxes (foreign and domestic) divided by income before income taxes, extraordinary items, and other adjustments on a tax equivalent basis. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Applicable Income Taxes Plus Tax Equivalent Adjustment / Pretax Net Operating Income Plus Tax Equivalency Adjustment
entries.basis: Pretax Net Operating Income Plus Tax Equivalency Adjustment
entries.definition: Applicable income taxes (foreign and domestic) plus the total tax equivalent adjustment divided by income before income taxes, extraordinary items, and other adjustments on a tax equivalent basis. entries.label: Real Estate Loans
entries.definition: Loans secured by real estate, including construction and land development loans and loans secured by farmland, by oneto four-family and multifamily (five dwelling units or more) residential properties, and by nonfarm nonresidential properties.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.definition: Loans for commercial and industrial purposes to sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises, which are secured (other than by real estate) or unsecured, single-payment or installment.

entries.label: Loans to Individuals
entries.definition: Loans to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures including credit card and related plans.

entries.label: Loans to Depository Institutions and Acceptances of Other Banks
entries.definition: Loans to U.S. and foreign banks and other depository institutions.

entries.label: Agricultural Loans
entries.definition: Loans to finance agricultural production and other loans to farmers.

entries.label: Other Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The sum of loans, net of unearned income, to foreign governments and official institutions, loans to nondepository institutions, loans for purchasing or carrying securities (including margin loans), all other loans, and lease financing receivables.

entries.label: Unearned Income
entries.definition: The amount of unearned income that is included in the loan categories listed above. (A value of zero implies that the above loan categories are reported net of unearned income.)

entries.label: Loans and Leases, Net of Unearned Income
entries.definition: The sum of real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, loans to individuals, loans to depository institutions, agricultural loans, loans to foreign governments and institutions, and other loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The allowance for credit losses on loans and leases. Prior to 2001, this item also included the amount of any allocated transfer risk reserve.

entries.label: Net Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Total loans and leases, net of unearned income, minus the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases (and allocated transfer risk reserve prior to 2001).

entries.label: Debt Securities That Reprice or Mature in over 1 Year
entries.definition: The amortized cost of held-to-maturity and the fair value of available-for-sale debt securities with a remaining maturity of more than one year.

entries.label: Mutual Funds and Equity Securities
entries.definition: The fair value of investments in mutual funds and equity securities that are designated as available for sale.

entries.label: Subtotal
entries.definition: The sum of loans and leases (net of unearned income and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases), securities that reprice or mature in over one year, and mutual funds and equity securities.

entries.label: Interest-Bearing Bank Balances
entries.definition: Interest-bearing balances due from depository institutions and foreign central banks that are held in the holding company’s U.S. and foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, International Banking Facilities, or consolidated subsidiaries.

entries.label: Federal Funds Sold and Reverse Repos
entries.definition: Unsecured loans of immediately available balances, and purchase of securities, loans, other assets, or participations in pools of securities under agreements to resell for one business day or under a continuing contract.

entries.label: Debt Securities That Reprice or Mature Within 1 Year
entries.definition: Debt securities with a remaining maturity or current repricing interval of one year or less.

entries.label: Trading Assets
entries.definition: Assets held in the consolidated holding company’s trading accounts.

entries.label: Total Earning Assets
entries.definition: The sum of interest-bearing balances due from depository institutions, debt and equity securities, federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell, loans and leases (net of unearned income and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases), and trading assets.

entries.label: Non-Interest-Bearing Cash and Due from Depository Institutions
entries.definition: Non-interest-bearing balances due from depository institutions, currency and coin, cash items in the process of collection, and unposted debits.

entries.label: Premises, Fixed Assets, and Right-of-Use Assets
entries.definition: The book value, less accumulated depreciation or amortization, of all premises, equipment, furniture, and fixtures purchased directly or acquired by means of a rights of use asset.

entries.label: Other Real Estate Owned
entries.definition: Other real estate owned.

entries.label: Investment in Unconsolidated Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The sum of the consolidated holding company’s holdings of capital stock in unconsolidated subsidiaries and associated companies, its proportionate share in their earnings or losses since the date of their acquisition, and any advances made to them including those in the form of loans and holdings of their bonds and debentures.

entries.label: Intangible and Other Assets
entries.definition: The sum of goodwill (the excess of the unamortized acquisition cost of consolidated subsidiaries over the net underlying assets), mortgage servicing assets, purchased credit card relationships and nonmortgage servicing assets, other identifiable intangible assets such as trademarks, patents, and franchises, direct and indirect investments in real estate ventures, and all other assets.

entries.label: Total Assets
entries.definition: The dollar amount of total assets.

entries.label: Quarterly Average Assets
entries.definition: Average consolidated assets for the quarter as reported in Schedule HC-K of the FR Y-9C. 38 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Average Loans and Leases (YTD)
entries.definition: The year-to-date quarterly average sum of loans and leases in domestic and foreign offices, net of unearned income (four-point average).

entries.label: Loans Held-For-Sale
entries.definition: Total loans and leases held-for-sale.

entries.label: Loans Not Held-For-Sale
entries.definition: Total loans and leases not held-for-sale.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans Secured by 1–4 Family
entries.definition: The sum of revolving open-end loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties and extended under lines of credit and other oneto four-family loans secured by first and junior liens.

entries.label: Commercial Real Estate Loans
entries.definition: The sum of construction, land development, and other land loans; loans secured by multifamily residential properties; and loans secured by nonfarm nonresidential properties.

entries.label: Construction and Land Development
entries.definition: Loans secured by real estate to finance either land development prior to erecting a new structure or the on-site construction of industrial, commercial, residential, or farm buildings.

entries.label: Multifamily
entries.definition: Loans secured by multifamily (five dwelling units or more) residential properties.

entries.label: Nonfarm Nonresidential
entries.definition: Real estate loans secured by business or industrial properties, hotels, motels, churches, hospitals, educational and charitable institutions, dormitories, clubs, lodges, association buildings, “homes” for aged persons and orphans, golf courses, recreational facilities, and similar properties.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans Secured by Farmland
entries.definition: Loans secured by land used or usable for agricultural purposes and improvements thereon.

entries.label: Total Investment Securities
entries.definition: The sum of the amortized cost of held-to-maturity debt securities and the current fair value of available-for-sale debt and equity securities described in various categories below.

entries.label: U.S. Treasury Securities
entries.definition: The amount of U.S. Treasury securities.

entries.label: U.S. Agency Securities excluding Mortgage-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The amount of U.S. government agency and corporation obligations, excluding mortgage-backed securities. For holding companies with less than $1 billion in assets, the BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Municipal Securities
entries.definition: Obligations of states and political subdivisions in the United States.

entries.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The amount of pass-through and other mortgage-backed securities, including CMOs, REMICs, and stripped mortgagebacked securities. For holding companies with less than $1 billion in assets, the BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Asset-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The sum of asset-backed securities and structured financial products. The BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Other Debt Securities
entries.definition: The sum of other U.S. debt securities and foreign debt securities.

entries.label: Mutual Funds and Equity Securities
entries.definition: The values of investments in mutual funds and equity securities that are designated as available-for-sale.

entries.label: Available-for-Sale Securities
entries.definition: The fair value of available-for-sale debt and equity securities included in the categories below.

entries.label: U.S. Treasury Securities (Available-for-Sale Securities)
entries.definition: The amount of U.S. Treasury securities designated as available-for-sale.

entries.label: U.S. Agency Securities excluding Mortgage-Backed Securities (Available-for-Sale Securities)
entries.definition: The amount of U.S. government agency and corporation obligations, excluding mortgage-backed securities, that is designated as available-for-sale. For holding companies with less than $1 billion in assets, the BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Municipal Securities (Available-for-Sale Securities)
entries.definition: The fair value of available-for-sale obligations of states and political subdivisions in the United States.

entries.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities (Available-for-Sale Securities)
entries.definition: The amount of pass-through and other mortgage-backed securities, including CMOS, REMICS, and stripped mortgagebacked securities designated as available-for-sale. For holding companies with less than $1 billion in assets, the BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Asset-Backed Securities (Available-for-Sale Securities)
entries.definition: The sum of asset-backed securities and structured financial products, designated as available-for-sale. The BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Other Debt Securities (Available-for-Sale Securities)
entries.definition: The fair value of other U.S. debt securities and foreign debt securities that are designated as available-for-sale.

entries.label: Mutual Funds and Equity Securities (Available-for-Sale Securities)
entries.definition: The values of investments in mutual funds and equity securities that are designated as available-for-sale.

entries.label: Held-to-Maturity Securities Appreciation (Depreciation)
entries.definition: The difference between the fair value and the amortized cost of all debt securities that are designated as held-tomaturity.

entries.label: Available-for-Sale Securities Appreciation (Depreciation)
entries.definition: The difference between the fair value and the amortized cost of all debt and equity securities that are designated as available-for-sale.

entries.label: Structured Notes, Fair Value
entries.definition: The fair value of structured notes (debt securities with cash flow characteristics that depend upon one or more indices and/or that have embedded forwards or options). Examples of structured notes include step-up bonds, index amortizing notes (IANs), dual index notes, deleveraged bonds, range bonds, inverse floaters, and floating debt securities in which interest payments are based on a single index such as Constant Maturity Treasury (CMT) or Cost of Funds Index (COFI). 40 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Pledged Securities
entries.definition: Securities that are pledged to secure deposits, repurchase transactions, or other borrowings as performance bonds under futures or forward contracts or for any other purpose. entries.label: Demand Deposits
entries.definition: Non-interest-bearing demand deposits held in domestic offices of commercial bank subsidiaries.

entries.label: NOW, ATS, and Transaction Accounts
entries.definition: Accounts subject to negotiable orders of withdrawal (NOW accounts), ATS accounts (accounts subject to automatic transfer from savings accounts), and all other transaction accounts excluding demand deposits.

entries.label: Time Deposits Less Brokered Deposits under $250 Thousand
entries.definition: All time deposits, including time certificates of deposit and open-account time deposits with balances of less than $250,000, minus brokered deposits issued in denominations below $250,000. For reporting dates prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000.

entries.label: MMDA and Other Savings Accounts
entries.definition: All savings deposits including money market deposit accounts (MMDAs) other than negotiable orders of withdrawal (NOW accounts), ATS accounts (accounts subject to automatic transfer from savings accounts), or other transaction accounts.

entries.label: Other Non-Interest-Bearing Deposits
entries.definition: Non-interest-bearing deposit balances held in domestic offices of other depository institutions that are subsidiaries of the holding company.

entries.label: Core Deposits
entries.definition: The sum of demand deposits, NOW, ATS, and transaction accounts, time deposits (excluding brokered deposits) with balances under $250,000, money market deposit accounts, other savings accounts, and other non-interestbearing deposit balances. For reporting dates prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000.

entries.label: Time Deposits of $250 Thousand or More
entries.definition: Time deposits including time certificates of deposit and open-account deposits with balances of $250,000 or more, regardless of negotiability or transferability. For reporting dates prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000.

entries.label: Foreign Deposits
entries.definition: Deposits in foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, and International Banking Facilities.

entries.label: Federal Funds Purchased and Repos
entries.definition: Borrowings in the form of immediately available funds or sale of securities, loans, participations in pools of securities, or other assets under agreements to repurchase for one business day or under a continuing contract.

entries.label: Secured Federal Funds Purchased
entries.definition: The amount of “federal funds purchased in domestic offices” that are secured.

entries.label: Commercial Paper
entries.definition: Short-term and uncollateralized negotiable promissory notes issued by the holding company or its subsidiaries, usually with a maturity of 270 days or less.

entries.label: Other Borrowings with a Remaining Maturity of 1 Year or Less
entries.definition: Funds borrowed by the consolidated holding company with a remaining maturity of one year or less, including mortgage indebtedness and obligations under capitalized leases with a remaining maturity of one year or less.

entries.label: Other Borrowings with a Remaining Maturity over 1 Year
entries.definition: Funds borrowed by the consolidated holding company with a remaining maturity of more than one year, including mortgage indebtedness and obligations under capitalized leases with a remaining maturity of more than one year.

entries.label: Brokered Deposits under $250 Thousand
entries.definition: Brokered deposits issued in denominations of less than $250,000. For reporting dates prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000.

entries.label: Noncore Funding
entries.definition: The sum of time deposits of $250,000 or more, deposits in foreign offices and in Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase in domestic offices including those of Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, commercial paper, other borrowings (including mortgage indebtedness and obligations under capitalized leases), and brokered deposits less than $250,000. For reporting dates prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000.

entries.label: Trading Liabilities
entries.definition: Liabilities arising from trading activities, including liabilities resulting from sales of assets not owned by the holding company and revaluation losses on interest rate, foreign exchange rate, and other commodity and equity contracts entered into by the holding company for trading, dealer, customer accommodation, or similar purposes.

entries.label: Subordinated Notes and Debentures and Trust Preferred Securities (Consolidated)
entries.definition: Outstanding notes and debentures that are subordinated to the deposits of subsidiary depository institutions and any other debt that is designated as subordinated in its indenture agreement. This line item includes subordinated perpetual debt, limited-life preferred stock and related surplus, equity commitment and contracted notes that qualify as capital under the Federal Reserve Board’s capital adequacy guidelines, and subordinated notes payable to trusts issuing trust preferred securities.

entries.label: Other Liabilities
entries.definition: The amount of other liabilities.

entries.label: Total Liabilities
entries.definition: The sum of core deposits, noncore funding, trading liabilities, subordinated notes and debentures, acceptances, and other liabilities.

entries.label: Perpetual Preferred Stock (Including Surplus)
entries.definition: The aggregate par or stated value of all outstanding perpetual preferred stock including any amounts received in excess of its par or stated value.

entries.label: Common Stock
entries.definition: The aggregate par or stated value of common stock issued.

entries.label: Common Surplus
entries.definition: The amount formally transferred to the surplus account, including capital contributions, and any amount received for common stock in excess of its par or stated value.

entries.label: Retained Earnings
entries.definition: The amount of retained earnings, including capital reserves, which result from the transfer of net income, declaration of dividends, transfers to surplus, or other appropriate entries. 44 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income
entries.definition: The amount of other comprehensive income in conformity with ASC Subtopic 220-10, Comprehensive Income— Overall (formerly FASB Statement No. 130, Reporting Comprehensive Income). Other comprehensive income includes net unrealized holding gains (losses) on available-for-sale securities, accumulated net gains (losses) on cash flow hedges, foreign currency translation adjustments, and minimum pension liability adjustments. From March 31, 1999, to December 31, 2000, this item includes net unrealized holding gains (losses) on available-for-sale securities, accumulated net gains (losses) reported on cash flow hedges, and foreign currency translation adjustments. Prior to March 31, 1999, accumulated net gains (losses) on cash flow hedges were not reported on the FR Y-9C and are not included in this item.

entries.label: Other Equity Capital Components
entries.definition: The amount of all other equity capital components, including unearned Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) shares.

entries.label: Total Holding Company Equity Capital
entries.definition: The sum of perpetual preferred stock (including surplus), common stock and surplus, retained earnings, accumulated other comprehensive income, and other equity capital components, less treasury stock.

entries.label: Total Equity Capital, Including Minority Interest
Total Liabilities and Capital
entries.definition: The sum of total liabilities and total holding company equity capital, and noncontrolling (minority) interest in subsidiaries.

entries.label: Non-Interest-Bearing Deposits
entries.definition: Domestic and foreign deposit accounts on which the issuing depository institution pays no compensation to the holder for the use of the funds. They include matured time deposits that are not automatically renewable unless the deposit agreement specifies the transfer of funds at maturity to another type of account and deposits with a 0 percent stated interest rate that are issued at face value.

entries.label: Interest-Bearing Deposits
entries.definition: Domestic and foreign deposit accounts on which the issuing depository institution pays compensation to the holder for the use of the funds. They include deposits with a 0 percent interest rate that are issued on a discount basis.

entries.label: Total Deposits
entries.definition: The sum of non-interest and interest-bearing deposits in domestic and foreign offices.

entries.label: Long-Term Debt That Reprices within 1 Year
entries.definition: Long-term debt issued by the holding company with a remaining maturity of more than one year, but that has a repricing frequency of less than one year. Mortgage indebtedness and obligations under capitalized leases and limited-life preferred stock are excluded from this line item.

entries.label: Changes in Holding Company Equity Capital
Holding Company Equity Capital, Previous Year-End, as Amended
entries.definition: Total holding company equity capital balance as of December 31 of the previous year after the effect of adjustments made in amended reports.

entries.label: Accounting Restatements
entries.definition: The cumulative effect (net of applicable income taxes) of changes in accounting principles that resulted in the restatement of prior years’ financial statements and the sum of all corrections (net of applicable income taxes) due to material accounting errors made in prior years’ financial statements that were not corrected in an amended report for the period during which the error was made.

entries.label: Net Income
entries.definition: Net income (or loss) for the calendar year-to-date.

entries.label: Net Sale of New Perpetual Preferred Stock
entries.definition: Change in holding company equity capital during the calendar year-to-date resulting from the issuance of new perpetual preferred stock (net of expenses associated with the issuance of such stock), conversion of convertible debt or limited-life preferred stock into perpetual preferred stock, exercise of stock options, and retirement of perpetual preferred stock.

entries.label: Net Sale of New Common Stock
entries.definition: Change in holding company equity capital during the calendar year-to-date resulting from the issuance of common stock (net of expenses associated with the issuance of such stock), conversion of convertible debt, limited-life preferred, or perpetual preferred stock into common stock, exercise of stock options, and retirement of common stock.

entries.label: Sale of Treasury Stock
entries.definition: The resale or other disposal of the holding company’s own perpetual preferred stock or common stock during the calendar year-to-date.

entries.label: Purchase of Treasury Stock
entries.definition: The acquisition, without retirement, of the holding company’s own perpetual preferred stock or common stock during the calendar year-to-date.

entries.label: Changes Incident to Business Combinations
entries.definition: For business combinations that are treated as pooling of interests, the historical equity capital balances of the consolidated holding company or other businesses acquired as of the end of the previous calendar year. For business combinations treated as purchases, the fair value of any perpetual preferred or common shares issued (minus the direct cost of issuing the shares) less any goodwill charged against undivided profits. This line item includes any retroactive adjustments resulting from the realization of income tax benefits of pre-acquisition operating loss carry-forwards of purchased subsidiaries and other purchased businesses.

entries.label: Dividends Declared
entries.definition: Cash dividends declared on preferred stock and common stock during the calendar year-to-date, including dividends not payable until after the report date.

entries.label: Changes in Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income
entries.definition: The amount of other comprehensive income for the calendar year-to-date.

entries.label: Changes in the Debit to ESOP Liability
entries.definition: (For holding companies that guaranteed the debt of their Employee Stock Ownership Plan only.) Changes during the calendar year-to-date to the offsetting debit to the liability recorded by the holding company in connection with ESOP debt guaranteed by the holding company. 46 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Other Adjustments to Holding Company Equity Capital
entries.definition: The amount of all other adjustments during the calendar year-to-date to holding company equity capital, including contributions of capital to the holding company when the company is a partnership.

entries.label: Holding Company Equity Capital, Ending Balance
Real Estate Loans
entries.definition: Loans secured by real estate, including construction and land development loans and loans secured by farmland, by oneto four-family and multifamily (five or more) residential properties, and by nonfarm nonresidential properties, divided by total assets.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.definition: Loans for commercial and industrial purposes to sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises, which are secured (other than by real estate) or unsecured, single-payment or installment, divided by total assets.

entries.label: Loans to Individuals
entries.definition: Loans to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures divided by total assets.

entries.label: Loans to Depository Institutions and Acceptances of Other Banks
entries.definition: Loans to U.S. and foreign banks and other depository institutions, including acceptances of other banks, divided by total assets.

entries.label: Agricultural Loans
entries.definition: Agricultural loans divided by total assets.

entries.label: Other Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans to foreign governments and official institutions, loans to nondepository financial institutions, loans for purchasing or carrying securities (including margin loans), all other loans (excluding consumer loans), and lease financing receivables divided by total assets.

entries.label: Net Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and leases net of unearned income, and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by total assets.

entries.label: Debt Securities over 1 Year
entries.definition: Debt securities with a remaining maturity of more than one year divided by total assets.

entries.label: Mutual Funds and Equity Securities
entries.definition: Investments in mutual funds and equity securities divided by total assets.

entries.label: Subtotal
entries.definition: The sum of net loans and lease financing receivables, debt securities with a remaining maturity more than one year, and investments in mutual funds and equity securities divided by total assets.

entries.label: Interest-Bearing Bank Balances
entries.definition: Interest-bearing bank balances divided by total assets.

entries.label: Federal Funds Sold and Reverse Repos
entries.definition: Federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell divided by total assets.

entries.label: Debt Securities with Maturity of 1 Year or Less
entries.definition: Debt securities with a remaining maturity of one year or less divided by total assets.

entries.label: Trading Assets
entries.definition: Assets held in trading accounts divided by total assets.

entries.label: Total Earning Assets
entries.definition: The sum of interest-bearing balances due from depository institutions, investment securities, federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell, loans and leases (net of unearned income, and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases), and trading assets divided by total assets.

entries.label: Cash and Non-Interest-Bearing Balances Due from Depository Institutions
entries.definition: The sum of non-interest-bearing balances due from depository institutions and currency and coin divided by total assets.

entries.label: Other Real Estate Owned
entries.definition: Other real estate owned divided by total assets.

entries.label: All Other Assets
entries.definition: The sum of premises and fixed assets, other real estate owned, investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries and associated companies, direct and indirect investments in real estate ventures, intangible assets, and other assets divided by total assets.

entries.label: Short-Term Investments
entries.definition: The sum of interest-bearing bank balances, federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell, and debt securities with a remaining maturity of one year or less, divided by total assets.

entries.label: U.S. Treasury Securities
entries.definition: The sum of the amortized cost of held-to-maturity U.S. Treasury securities and the fair value of available-for-sale U.S. Treasury securities divided by total assets. 50 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: U.S. Agency Securities excluding Mortgage-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The amount of U.S. government agency and corporation obligations, excluding mortgage-backed securities divided by total assets. For holding companies with less than $1 billion in assets, the BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Municipal Securities
entries.definition: Obligations of state and political subdivisions in the United States divided by total assets.

entries.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The amount of pass-through and other mortgage-backed securities, including CMOs, REMICs, and stripped mortgagebacked securities, divided by total assets. For holding companies with less than $1 billion in assets, the BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Asset-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The amount of asset-backed securities, other than mortgage-backed securities, divided by total assets. The BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Other Debt Securities
entries.definition: The sum of all other debt securities divided by total assets.

entries.label: Loans Held-For-Sale
entries.definition: Total loans held-for-sale divided by total assets.

entries.label: Loans Held for Investment
entries.definition: Loans and leases held for investment, net of unearned income, divided by total assets.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans Secured by 1–4 Family
entries.definition: Revolving and permanent loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties divided by total assets.

entries.label: Revolving
entries.definition: Revolving open-end lines of credit secured by oneto four-family residential properties divided by total assets.

entries.label: Closed-End, Secured by First Liens
entries.definition: Permanent loans secured by first liens on oneto four-family residential properties divided by total assets.

entries.label: Closed-End, Secured by Junior Liens
entries.definition: Permanent loans secured by junior (other than the first) liens on oneto four-family residential properties divided by total assets.

entries.label: Commercial Real Estate Loans
entries.definition: Loans secured by real estate including construction, land development and other land loans, and loans secured by multifamily residential properties and nonfarm nonresidential properties divided by total assets.

entries.label: Construction and Land Development
entries.definition: Loans secured by real estate made to finance the construction of new structures, additions, alterations, or demolitions to make way for new structures divided by total assets.

entries.label: Multifamily
entries.definition: Loans secured by multifamily (five dwelling units or more) residential properties divided by total assets.

entries.label: Nonfarm Nonresidential
entries.definition: Real estate loans secured by business and industrial properties, hotels, motels, churches, hospitals, educational and charitable institutions, dormitories, clubs, lodges, association buildings, “homes” for aged persons and orphans, golf courses, recreational facilities, and similar properties divided by total assets.

Real Estate Loans
entries.basis: Percent of Gross Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans secured by real estate including construction and land development loans and loans secured by farmland, by oneto four-family and multifamily (five or more) residential properties, and by nonfarm nonresidential properties divided by total loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans Secured by 1–4 Family
entries.basis: Percent of Gross Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Revolving and permanent loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties divided by total loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Revolving
entries.basis: Percent of Gross Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Revolving open-end lines of credit secured by oneto four-family residential properties divided by total loans and leases, net of unearned income.
