entries.label: Short-Term Investments
entries.definition: The sum of interest-bearing bank balances, federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell, and debt securities with a remaining maturity of one year or less, divided by total assets.

entries.label: Liquid Assets
entries.definition: The sum of cash and balances due from depository institutions, U.S. Treasury securities, obligations of other U.S. government agencies and corporations, trading assets, and federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell divided by total assets. A small holding company that qualifies for abbreviated reporting of securities balances reports also in the denominator of this ratio the balance of pass-through residential mortgagebacked securities that are not guaranteed or issued by U.S. government agencies and corporations. (See Reporting Burden Reduction for Small Holding Companies in section 2.)

entries.label: Investment Securities
entries.definition: The sum of the amortized cost of held-to-maturity debt securities and the fair value of available-for-sale debt and equity securities divided by total assets.

entries.label: Net Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables net of unearned income and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by total assets.

entries.label: Net Loans, Leases, and Standby Letters of Credit
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables net of unearned income and the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases plus standby letters of credit divided by total assets.

entries.label: Core Deposits
entries.definition: The sum of demand deposits, NOW, ATS, and transaction accounts, time deposits (excluding brokered deposits) with balances under $250,000, money market deposit accounts, other savings accounts, and other non-interestbearing deposit balances divided by total assets. Prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000.

entries.label: Noncore Funding
entries.definition: The sum of time deposits with balances of $250,000 or more, deposits in foreign offices and Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase, commercial paper, other borrowings (including mortgage indebtedness and obligations under capitalized leases), and brokered deposits less than $250,000 divided by total assets. Prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000.

entries.label: Time Deposits of $250 Thousand or More
entries.definition: Time deposits of $250,000 or more divided by total assets. Prior to March 31, 2017, the deposits threshold was $100,000.

entries.label: Foreign Deposits
entries.definition: Deposits in foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, and International Banking Facilities divided by total assets.

entries.label: Federal Funds Purchased and Repos
entries.definition: Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase divided by total assets.

entries.label: Secured Federal Funds Purchased
entries.definition: The amount of federal funds purchased in domestic offices that are secured divided by total assets.

entries.label: Net Federal Funds Purchased (Sold)
entries.definition: The difference between federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase in domestic offices of the holding company, of its Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, and in International Banking Facilities (a liability item) and federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell in domestic offices of the holding company, of its Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, and in International Banking Facilities (an asset item) divided by total assets.

entries.label: Commercial Paper
entries.definition: Commercial paper divided by total assets.

entries.label: Other Borrowings with Remaining Maturity of 1 Year or Less
entries.definition: Other borrowings with a remaining maturity of one year or less divided by total assets.

entries.label: Earning Assets That Reprice within 1 Year
entries.definition: Earning assets that reprice within one year or mature within one year divided by total assets.

entries.label: Interest-Bearing Liabilities That Reprice within 1 Year
entries.definition: Interest-bearing deposit liabilities that reprice within one year or mature within one year divided by total assets.

entries.label: Long-Term Debt That Reprices within 1 Year
entries.definition: Long-term debt (other borrowed money with a remaining maturity of more than one year, or subordinated notes and debentures) that has a repricing frequency of less than one year divided by total assets.

entries.label: Net Assets That Reprice within 1 Year
entries.definition: The difference between earning assets that reprice or that mature within one year and the sum of interest-bearing deposit liabilities that reprice or mature within one year and long-term debt that reprices within one year divided by total assets. 62 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Net Noncore Funding Dependence
entries.definition: The difference between noncore funding and short-term investments divided by long-term assets. See the definitions of noncore funding, short-term investments, and long-term assets under the heading “Liquidity and Funding” in the description of Summary Ratios (BHCPR page 1) in this section.

entries.label: Net Short-Term Noncore Funding Dependence
entries.definition: The difference between short-term noncore funding and short-term investments divided by long-term assets. See the definitions of short-term noncore funding, short-term investments, and long-term assets under the heading “Liquidity and Funding” in the description of Summary Ratios (BHCPR page 1) in this section.

entries.label: Short-Term Investments / Short-Term Noncore Funding
entries.definition: Short-term investments divided by short-term noncore funding. See the definitions of short-term investments and short-term noncore funding under the heading “Liquidity and Funding” in the description of Summary Ratios (BHCPR page 1) in this section.

entries.label: Liquid Assets Less Short-Term Noncore Funding / Nonliquid Assets
entries.definition: Liquid assets (the sum of cash and balances due from depository institutions, trading assets, federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell, and U.S. Treasury securities and obligations of other U.S. government agencies and corporations) less short-term noncore funding divided by total assets less liquid assets. See the definition of short-term noncore funding under the heading “Liquidity and Funding” in the description of Summary Ratios (BHCPR page 1) in this section.

entries.label: Net Loans and Leases / Total Deposits
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables, net of unearned income and allowance for losses divided by total deposits.

entries.label: Net Loans and Leases / Core Deposits
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables, net of unearned income and allowance for losses, divided by core deposits.

entries.label: Held-to-Maturity Securities Appreciation (Depreciation) / Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: The difference between the fair value and the amortized cost of held-to-maturity securities divided by tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Available-for-Sale Securities Appreciation (Depreciation) / Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: The difference between the fair value and the amortized cost of available-for-sale securities divided by tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Structured Notes Appreciation (Depreciation) / Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: The difference between the fair value and the amortized cost of structured notes divided by tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Held-to-Maturity Securities
entries.definition: The amortized cost of debt securities that the holding company has the positive intent and ability to hold to maturity, divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: Available-for-Sale Securities
entries.definition: The fair value of equity and debt securities designated available-for-sale divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: U.S. Treasury Securities
entries.definition: The amount of U.S. Treasury securities (the sum of the amortized cost of held-to-maturity securities and the fair value of available-for-sale securities) divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: U.S. Agency Securities Excluding Mortgage-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The amount of U.S. government agency and corporation obligations, excluding mortgage-backed securities (the sum of the amortized cost of held-to-maturity securities and the fair value of available-for-sale securities), divided by total investment securities. For holding companies with less than $1 billion in assets, the BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Municipal Securities
entries.definition: Obligations of states and political subdivisions in the United States (the sum of the amortized cost of held-tomaturity securities and the fair value of available-for-sale securities) divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The amount of pass-through and other mortgage-backed securities, including CMOs, REMICs, and stripped mortgagebacked securities (the sum of the amortized cost of held-to-maturity securities and the fair value of available-forsale securities), divided by total investment securities. For holding companies with less than $1 billion in assets, the BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Asset-Backed Securities
entries.definition: The amount of asset-backed securities (the sum of the amortized cost of held-to-maturity securities and the fair value of available-for-sale securities), other than mortgage-backed securities, divided by total investment securities. The BHCPR includes data for this item only for report dates after December 31, 2000.

entries.label: Other Debt Securities
entries.definition: Other debt securities (the sum of the amortized cost of held-to-maturity securities and the fair value of availablefor-sale securities) divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: Mutual Funds and Equity Securities
entries.definition: The fair value of investments in mutual funds and equity securities divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: Debt Securities 1 Year or Less
entries.definition: Debt securities with a remaining maturity of one year or less divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: Debt Securities 1 to 5 Years
entries.definition: Debt securities with a remaining maturity of over one year, to five years divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: Debt Securities over 5 Years
entries.definition: Debt securities with a remaining maturity of over five years divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: Pledged Securities
entries.definition: Pledged securities divided by total investment securities. 64 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Structured Notes, Fair Value
entries.definition: The fair value of structured notes divided by total investment securities.

entries.label: Loan Commitments
entries.definition: The unused portion of commitments that obligate the holding company to extend credit in the form of loans or participation in loans, lease financing receivables, or similar transactions. These include revolving open-end loans secured by residential and commercial real estate, construction and land development, credit card lines, securities underwriting, and other unused commitments. From September 30, 2018, this item is reported only semiannually, in June and December.

entries.label: Commitments to Fund Loans Secured by Commercial Real Estate
entries.definition: The unused portion of commitments to extend credit to finance commercial real estate, construction, and land development loans secured by real estate.

entries.label: Commitments to Fund Real Estate Loans That Are Unsecured
entries.definition: The unused portion of commitments to extend credit to finance commercial real estate, construction, and land development loans not secured by real estate.

entries.label: Credit Card Lines
entries.definition: The unused portion of commitments to extend credit to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures and to commercial or industrial enterprises through credit cards. From September 30, 2018, this item is reported only semiannually, in June and December.

entries.label: Securities Underwriting
entries.definition: The unsold portion of the consolidated holding company’s own takedown of securities underwriting transactions.

entries.label: Standby Letters of Credit
entries.definition: Outstanding and unused financial and performance standby letters of credit, including guarantees issued by foreign offices.

entries.label: Commercial and Similar Letters of Credit
entries.definition: Outstanding and unused amounts of issued or confirmed commercial letters of credit, travelers’ letters of credit not issued for money or its equivalent, and all similar letters of credit, excluding standby letters of credit.

entries.label: Securities Lent
entries.definition: The amount of securities lent against collateral or on an uncollateralized basis.

entries.label: Credit Derivatives (Holding Company as Guarantor)
entries.definition: The sum of the notional amounts of credit default swaps, total return swaps, credit options, and other credit derivatives for which the holding company or any of its consolidated subsidiaries has extended credit protection to other parties.

entries.label: Credit Derivatives (Holding Company as Beneficiary)
entries.definition: The sum of the notional amounts of credit default swaps, total return swaps, credit options, and other credit derivatives for which the holding company or any of its consolidated subsidiaries has obtained a guarantee against credit losses from other parties.

entries.label: Credit Derivative Contracts—Investment Grade
entries.definition: The sum of the notional principal amounts of all investment grade reference asset credit derivative contracts that are subject to risk-based capital requirements.

entries.label: Credit Derivative Contracts—Non-investment Grade
entries.definition: The sum of the notional principal amounts of all non-investment grade reference asset credit derivative contracts that are subject to risk-based capital requirements.

entries.label: Interest Rate Futures and Forward Contracts
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of futures and forward contracts that commit the consolidated holding company to buy or sell financial instruments for which the predominate risk characteristic is interest rate risk.

entries.label: Written Options Contracts (Interest Rate)
entries.definition: The aggregate par value or notional amount of interest-bearing financial instruments which the holding company or its consolidated subsidiaries have obligated themselves to either purchase or sell under outstanding exchangetraded option contracts and over-the-counter option contracts for a fee or premium.

entries.label: Purchased Options Contracts (Interest Rate)
entries.definition: The aggregate par value or notional amount of interest-bearing financial instruments in which the holding company or its consolidated subsidiaries purchased, for a fee or premium, the right to either purchase or sell under outstanding exchange-traded option contracts and over-the-counter option contracts.

entries.label: Interest Rate Swaps
entries.definition: The notional value of outstanding interest rate and basis swaps to hedge the holding company’s or consolidated subsidiaries’ interest rate risk, in an intermediary capacity, or to hold in inventory.

entries.label: Futures and Forward Foreign Exchange
entries.definition: The gross amount in U.S. dollars of futures and forward contracts to purchase foreign currencies and U.S. dollar exchange.

entries.label: Written Options Contracts (Foreign Exchange)
entries.definition: The gross amount of foreign currencies and U.S. dollar exchange which the holding company or its consolidated subsidiaries have obligated themselves to either purchase or sell under outstanding exchange-traded and overthe-counter option contracts for a fee or premium.

entries.label: Purchased Options Contracts (Foreign Exchange)
entries.definition: The gross amount of foreign currency and U.S. dollar exchange that the holding company or its consolidated subsidiaries purchased, for a fee or premium, the right to either purchase or sell under outstanding exchangetraded and over-the-counter option contracts.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Rate Swaps
entries.definition: The notional principal value in U.S. dollars of outstanding cross-currency interest rate swaps to hedge the holding company’s or consolidated subsidiaries’ foreign exchange rate risk.

entries.label: Commodity and Other Futures and Forward Contracts
entries.definition: The contract amount of futures and forward commodity contracts that obligate the holding company or its consolidated subsidiaries to purchase or sell equity securities or instruments based on equity indexes, agricultural products, precious or nonferrous metals, or other contracts other than an interest or foreign exchange rate contract.

entries.label: Written Options Contracts (Commodity and Other)
entries.definition: The contract amount of exchange-traded and over-the-counter equity derivative options, commodity options, and any other options (that are not interest or foreign exchange rate contracts) in which the holding company or its consolidated subsidiaries have obligated themselves to either purchase or sell an equity instrument, an equity index, or a commodity or product for a fee or premium. 68 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Purchased Options Contracts (Commodity and Other)
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of exchange-traded and over-the-counter equity derivative options, commodity options, and any other options (that are not interest or foreign exchange rate contracts) in which the holding company or its consolidated subsidiaries have purchased the right to buy or sell for a fee or premium.

entries.label: Commodity and Other Swaps
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of outstanding equity or equity index swaps, and all other swap agreements, other than interest or foreign exchange rate contracts.

entries.label: Loan Commitments
entries.definition: The unused portion of commitments that obligate the holding company to extend credit in the form of loans or participation in loans, lease financing receivables, or similar transactions divided by total assets. From September 30, 2018, this item is reported only semiannually, in June and December.

entries.label: Standby Letters of Credit
entries.definition: Outstanding and unused standby letters of credit divided by total assets.

entries.label: Commercial and Similar Letters of Credit
entries.definition: Outstanding and unused amounts of issued and confirmed commercial letters of credit, travelers’ letters of credit not issued for money or its equivalent, and all similar letters of credit divided by total assets.

entries.label: Securities Lent
entries.definition: Securities lent divided by total assets.

entries.label: Credit Derivatives (Holding Company as Guarantor)
entries.definition: The sum of the notional amounts of credit default swaps, total return swaps, credit options, and other credit derivatives for which the holding company or any of its consolidated subsidiaries has extended credit protection to other parties divided by total assets.

entries.label: Credit Derivatives (Holding Company as Beneficiary)
entries.definition: The sum of the notional amounts of credit default swaps, total return swaps, credit options, and other credit derivatives for which the holding company or any of its consolidated subsidiaries has obtained a guarantee against credit losses from other parties divided by total assets.

entries.label: Credit Derivatives Contracts—Investment Grade
entries.definition: The sum of the notional principal amounts of all investment grade reference asset credit derivative contracts that are subject to risk-based capital requirements divided by total assets.

entries.label: Credit Derivatives Contracts—Non-investment Grade
entries.definition: The sum of the notional principal amounts of all non-investment grade reference asset credit derivative contracts that are subject to risk-based capital requirements divided by total assets.

entries.label: Derivative Contracts
entries.definition: The sum of interest rate contracts, foreign exchange contracts, equity derivative contracts, and commodity and other contracts on a consolidated basis divided by total assets.

entries.label: Interest Rate Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of interest rate contracts held for trading and for purposes other than trading divided by total assets. Interest rate contracts include single currency interest rate swaps, basis swaps, forward rate agreements, and interest rate options.

entries.label: Interest Rate Futures and Forward Contracts
entries.definition: Interest rate futures and forward contracts divided by total assets.

entries.label: Written Options Contracts (Interest Rate)
entries.definition: Written interest rate options contracts divided by total assets.

entries.label: Purchased Options Contracts (Interest Rate)
entries.definition: Purchased interest rate options contracts divided by total assets.

entries.label: Interest Rate Swaps
entries.definition: The notional value of interest rate swaps divided by total assets.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of foreign exchange rate contracts held for trading and for purposes other than trading divided by total assets. Foreign exchange contracts include cross-currency interest rate swaps, forward foreign exchange contracts, and currency futures and currency options.

entries.label: Futures and Forward Foreign Exchange Contracts
entries.definition: Futures and forward contracts to purchase foreign currencies and U.S. dollar exchange divided by total assets.

entries.label: Written Options Contracts (Foreign Exchange)
entries.definition: Written options contracts on foreign currencies and U.S. dollar exchange divided by total assets.

entries.label: Purchased Options Contracts (Foreign Exchange)
entries.definition: Purchased options contracts on foreign currencies and U.S. dollar exchange divided by total assets.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Rate Swaps
entries.definition: The notional principal value in U.S. dollars of outstanding cross-currency interest rate swaps divided by total assets.

entries.label: Equity, Commodity, and Other Derivative Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of equity derivative contracts as well as commodity and other contracts that are held for trading and for purposes other than trading divided by total assets. 70 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Commodity and Other Futures and Forward Contracts
entries.definition: The contract amount of futures and forward equity derivative contracts and commodity and other contracts divided by total assets.

entries.label: Written Options Contracts (Commodity and Other)
entries.definition: Written options contracts on individual stocks, stock index options, commodity options, and any other options (other than interest or foreign exchange rate contracts) divided by total assets.

entries.label: Purchased Options Contracts (Commodity and Other)
entries.definition: Purchased options contracts on individual stocks, stock index options, commodity options, and any other options (that are not interest or foreign exchange rate contracts) divided by total assets.

entries.label: Commodity and Other Swaps
entries.definition: The notional value of equity or equity index swaps and swaps other than interest rate swaps and foreign currency swaps divided by total assets.

entries.label: Percent of Average Loans and Leases
Loan Commitments
entries.basis: Percent of Average Loans and Leases

entries.label: Derivative Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of derivative contracts, which include interest rate contracts, foreign exchange contracts, equity derivative contracts, and commodity and other contracts.

entries.label: Interest Rate Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of interest rate derivative contracts held for trading or for purposes other than trading.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of foreign exchange derivative contracts held for trading or for purposes other than trading.

entries.label: Equity, Commodity, and Other Derivative Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of equity, commodity, and other derivative contracts held for trading or for purposes other than trading.

entries.label: Futures and Forwards
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of futures and forwards contracts for interest rate, foreign exchange, equity derivative, and commodity and other contracts.

entries.label: Written Options
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of exchange-traded and over-the-counter written options contracts for interest rate, foreign exchange, equity derivative, and commodity and other contracts.

entries.label: Exchange-Traded
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of exchange-traded written options contracts.

entries.label: Over-the-Counter
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of over-the-counter written options contracts.

entries.label: Purchased Options
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of exchange-traded and over-the-counter purchased options contracts for interest rate, foreign exchange, equity derivative, and commodity and other contracts.

entries.label: Exchange-Traded
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of exchange-traded purchased options contracts.

entries.label: Over-the-Counter
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of over-the-counter purchased options contracts.

entries.label: Swaps
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of swaps for interest rate, foreign exchange, equity derivative, and commodity and other contracts.

entries.label: Held for Trading
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of derivative contracts (interest rate contracts, foreign exchange contracts, equity derivative contracts, and commodity and other contracts) that are held for trading purposes. Besides derivative instruments used in dealing and other trading activities, this line item covers activities in which the holding company acquires or takes derivatives positions for sale in the near term or with the intent to resell (or repurchase) in order to profit from short-term price movements, accommodate customers’ needs, or hedge trading activities.

entries.label: Interest Rate Contracts (Held for Trading)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of interest rate contracts held for trading, including single currency interest rate swaps, basis swaps, forward rate agreements, and interest rate options, including caps, floor, collars, and corridors.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Contracts (Held for Trading)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of foreign exchange contracts held for trading.

entries.label: Equity, Commodity, and Other Derivative Contracts (Held for Trading)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of equity, commodity, and other derivative contracts that are held for trading.

entries.label: Non-Traded
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of derivative contracts held for purposes other than trading, including interest rate contracts, foreign exchange contracts, equity derivative contracts, and commodity and other contracts.

entries.label: Interest Rate Contracts (Non-Traded)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of interest rate contracts held for purposes other than trading.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Contracts (Non-Traded)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of foreign exchange contracts held for purposes other than trading.

entries.label: Equity, Commodity, and Other Derivative Contracts (Non-Traded)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of equity, commodity, and other derivative contracts held for purposes other than trading.

entries.label: Derivative Contracts (Excluding Futures and Foreign Exchange of 14 Days or Less)
entries.definition: The notional principal amounts of derivative contracts subject to risk-based capital requirements, excluding foreign exchange contracts with an original maturity of 14 days or less and futures contracts.

entries.label: One Year or Less
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of derivative contracts subject to risk-based capital requirements (excluding foreign exchange contracts with an original maturity of 14 days or less and futures contracts) that have a remaining maturity of one year or less.

entries.label: Over 1 Year to 5 Years
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of derivative contracts subject to risk-based capital requirements (excluding futures contracts) that have a remaining maturity of over one year through five years.

entries.label: Over 5 Years
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of derivative contracts subject to risk-based capital requirements (excluding futures contracts) that have a remaining maturity of over five years.

entries.label: Gross Negative Fair Value (Absolute Value)
entries.definition: The total fair value of derivative contracts with negative fair values. (The absolute value is displayed for this item.) 74 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Gross Positive Fair Value
entries.definition: The total fair value of derivative contracts with positive fair values.

entries.label: Held for Trading (Gross Positive Fair Value)
entries.definition: The total fair value of derivative contracts held for trading that have a positive fair value.

entries.label: Non-Traded (Gross Positive Fair Value)
entries.definition: The total fair value of derivatives contracts held for purposes other than trading that have a positive fair value.

entries.label: Current Credit Exposure on Risk-Based Capital Derivative Contracts
entries.definition: The current credit exposure (or the sum of positive fair values) across all derivative contracts that are covered by the risk-based capital standards.

entries.label: Credit Losses on Off-Balance-Sheet Derivative Contracts
entries.definition: The year-to-date credit losses incurred on derivative contracts regardless of whether the loss is charged directly to income (for example, trading revenue) or the allowance for credit losses on derivatives.

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due (Fair Value)
entries.definition: The fair value of all credit derivative contracts and all interest rate, foreign exchange rate, equity, and commodity and other derivative contracts on which a required payment by the holding company’s counterparty is past due 30 to 89 days. This item is confidential prior to March 31, 2001.

entries.label: Interest Rate Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of interest rate contracts divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of foreign exchange contracts divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Equity, Commodity and Other Contracts
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of equity, commodity, and other derivative contracts divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Futures and Forwards
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of futures and forward contracts divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Written Options
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of written options divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Exchange-Traded (Written Options)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of exchange-traded written options divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Over-the-Counter (Written Options)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of written options that are customized to meet the specific needs of counterparties to the transaction divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Purchased Options
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of purchased options divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Exchange-Traded (Purchased Options)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of exchange-traded purchased options divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Over-the-Counter (Purchased Options)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of purchased options that are customized to meet the specific needs of counterparties to the transaction divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Swaps
entries.definition: The notional amount of swaps divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Held for Trading
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of derivative contracts (interest rate contracts, foreign exchange contracts, equity derivative contracts, and commodity and other contracts) that are held for trading purposes divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Interest Rate Contracts (Held for Trading)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of interest rate contracts held for trading divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Contracts (Held for Trading)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of foreign exchange contracts held for trading divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Equity, Commodity, and Other Derivative Contracts (Held for Trading)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of equity, commodity, and other derivative contracts that are held for trading divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Non-Traded
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of derivative contracts held for purposes other than trading divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Interest Rate Contracts (Non-Traded)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount or par value of interest rate contracts held for purposes other than trading divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Foreign Exchange Contracts (Non-Traded)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of foreign exchange contracts held for purposes other than trading divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Equity, Commodity, and Other Derivative Contracts (Non-Traded)
entries.definition: The gross notional amount of equity, commodity, and other derivative contracts held for purposes other than trading divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Derivative Contracts (Excluding Futures and Foreign Exchange of 14 Days or Less)
entries.definition: The notional principal amounts of derivative contracts subject to risk-based capital requirements, excluding foreign exchange contracts with an original maturity of 14 days or less and futures contracts, divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts. 78 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: One Year or Less
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of derivative contracts subject to risk-based capital requirements (excluding foreign exchange contracts with an original maturity of 14 days or less and futures contracts) that have a remaining maturity of one year or less divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Over 1 Year to 5 Years
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of derivative contracts subject to risk-based capital requirements (excluding futures contracts) that have a remaining maturity of over one year through five years divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Over 5 Years
entries.definition: The notional amount or par value of derivative contracts subject to risk-based capital requirements (excluding futures contracts) that have a remaining maturity over five years divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Gross Negative Fair Value (Absolute Value)
entries.definition: The total fair value of derivative contracts with negative fair values (absolute value) divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Gross Positive Fair Value
entries.definition: The total fair value of derivative contracts with positive fair values divided by the total notional amount of derivative contracts.

entries.label: Gross Negative Fair Value (Absolute Value)
entries.definition: The total fair value of derivative contracts with negative fair values (absolute value) divided by tier 1 capital. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Gross Positive Fair Value
entries.definition: The total fair value of derivative contracts with positive fair values divided by tier 1 capital. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Held for Trading (Gross Positive Fair Value)
entries.definition: The total positive fair value of all derivative contracts held for trading divided by tier 1 capital. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Non-Traded (Gross Positive Fair Value)
entries.definition: The total positive fair value of all derivative contracts held for purposes other than trading divided by tier 1 capital. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Current Credit Exposure on Risk-Based Capital Derivative Contracts
entries.definition: The current credit exposure of derivatives covered under the risk-based capital standards divided by tier 1 capital. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Credit Losses on Derivatives
entries.definition: Year-to-date credit losses incurred on derivative contracts divided by tier 1 capital.

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due (Fair Value)
entries.definition: The fair value of all credit derivative contracts and all interest rate, foreign exchange rate, equity, and commodity and other derivative contracts on which a required payment by the holding company’s counterparty is past due 30 to 89 days divided by tier 1 capital. This item is confidential prior to March 2001.

entries.label: 90+ Days Past Due (Fair Value)
entries.definition: The fair value of all credit derivative contracts and all interest rate, foreign exchange rate, equity, and commodity and other derivative contracts on which a required payment by the holding company’s counterparty is past due for 90 days or more divided by tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Current Credit Exposure / Risk-Weighted Assets
entries.definition: The current credit exposure of derivatives covered by the risk-based capital standards divided by risk-weighted assets. section: Allowance and Net Credit Losses on Loans and Leases

entries.label: Change: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases, Excluding Allocated Transfer Risk Reserve
Beginning Balance
entries.definition: The balance of the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases at the end of the previous calendar year after the effect of all corrections and adjustments that were made in amended reports.

entries.label: Gross Losses
entries.definition: Loan and lease losses charged against the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases.

entries.label: Write-Downs from Transfers to Loans Held for Sale
entries.definition: The reduction in the value of loans transferred to the held-for-sale account through a write-down of the recorded investment to fair value upon transfer.

entries.label: Recoveries
entries.definition: Recoveries on amounts previously charged against the allowance for credit credit losses on loans and leases.

entries.label: Net Losses
entries.definition: Gross loan and lease losses minus recoveries.

entries.label: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses
entries.definition: The year-to-date provision for loan and lease losses.

entries.label: Adjustments
entries.definition: All other allowable adjustments during the reporting period.

entries.label: Ending Balance
entries.definition: The sum of the beginning allowance for loan and lease losses, the provision for credit losses on loans and leases, and adjustments minus net loan and lease losses.

entries.label: Memo: Allocated Transfer Risk Reserve (ATRR)
entries.definition: The required reserve for allocated transfer risk as specified in Section 905(a) of the International Lending Supervision Act of 1983, in the agency regulations implementing the Act (Subpart D of Federal Reserve Regulation K, Part 351 of the FDIC’s Rules and Regulations, and Part 20 of the Comptroller of the Currency’s Regulations), and in any guidelines, letters, or instructions issued by the agencies.

entries.label: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses / Average Assets
entries.definition: Provision for loan and lease losses divided by (four-point) average assets. (See Average Balances in section 2.)

entries.label: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses / Average Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Provision for loan and lease losses divided by (four-point) average loans and leases, net of unearned income. (See Average Balances in section 2.) 82 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Provision for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Net Credit Losses on Loans and Leases
entries.basis: Net Credit Losses on Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Provision for loan and lease losses divided by net credit losses on loans and leases.

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Total Loans and Leases Not Held-For-Sale
entries.basis: Total Loans and Leases Not Held-For-Sale
entries.definition: Allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by total loans and leases not held-for-sale.

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Total Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by loans and leases net of unearned income.

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Net Loan and Lease Losses (X)
entries.definition: The allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by net credit losses on loans and leases (annualized). If recoveries exceed gross credit losses on loans and leases, the BHCPR displays a blank in lieu of the ratio value or the percentile rank. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Nonaccrual Assets
entries.definition: The allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by the aggregate amount of nonaccrual assets.

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / 90 Days and over Past Due and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases
entries.basis: 90 Days and over Past Due and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The allowance for credit losses on loans and leases divided by the sum of loans and leases on which payment is due and unpaid for 90 days or more and those that are placed in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: Gross Credit Losses on Loans and Leases / Average Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Credit losses on loans and leases charged against the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases (annualized) divided by (four-point) average loans and leases, net of unearned income. (See Average Balances in section 2.)

entries.label: Recoveries / Average Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loan recoveries in the current year (annualized) divided by (four-point) average loans and leases, net of unearned income. (See Average Balances in section 2.)

entries.label: Net Losses / Average Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Gross loan and lease losses less recoveries divided by (four-point) average loans and leases, net of unearned income. (See Average Balances in section 2.)

entries.label: Write-Downs from Transfers to Loans Held for Sale / Average Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Total write-downs from transfers to loans held for sale divided by (four point) average loans and leases. (See Average Balances in section 2.)

entries.label: Recoveries / Prior Year-End Losses
entries.definition: Recoveries in the current year divided by gross loan and lease losses of the preceding calendar year.

entries.label: Earnings Coverage of Net Credit Losses on Loans and Leases (X)
entries.definition: The sum of income before taxes, minority interest, and extraordinary items and the provision for possible credit losses on loans and leases divided by net loan and lease losses. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Net Credit Losses on Loans and Leases by Type
Real Estate Loans
entries.definition: Net losses (gross charge-offs minus recoveries) on real estate loans divided by real estate loans, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans Secured by 1–4 Family
entries.definition: Net losses on real estate loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties divided by real estate loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Revolving
entries.definition: Net losses on revolving open-end real estate loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties and extended under lines of credit divided by the outstanding balance of revolving open-end real estate loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Closed-End
entries.definition: Net losses on other real estate loans secured by first and junior liens on oneto four-family residential properties divided by the outstanding balance of other real estate loans secured by first and junior liens on oneto four-family residential properties, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Commercial Real Estate Loans
entries.definition: Net losses on construction and land development loans and real estate loans secured by multifamily residential properties and nonfarm non-residential properties divided by the sum of the outstanding balances, gross of unearned income, of the same commercial real estate loan categories.

entries.label: Construction and Land Development
entries.definition: Net losses on construction and land development loans divided by the outstanding balance of construction and land development loans, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: 1–4 Family
entries.definition: Net losses on construction, land development, and other land loans in domestic offices for oneto four-family residential construction divided by the outstanding balance of construction and land development loans, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Other
entries.definition: Net losses on construction, land development, and other land loans in domestic offices for other construction loans and all land development and other land loans divided by the outstanding balance of construction and land development loans, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Multifamily
entries.definition: Net losses on real estate loans secured by multifamily (five dwelling units or more) residential properties divided by the outstanding balance of real estate loans secured by multifamily residential properties, gross of unearned income. 84 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Nonfarm Nonresidential
entries.definition: Net losses on real estate loans secured by nonfarm nonresidential properties divided by the outstanding balance of real estate loans secured by nonfarm nonresidential properties, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Owner-Occupied
entries.definition: Net losses on nonfarm nonresidential property loans secured by owner-occupied properties divided by the outstanding balance of real estate loans secured by nonfarm nonresidential properties, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Other
entries.definition: Net losses on nonfarm nonresidential property loans secured by other nonfarm nonresidential properties divided by the outstanding balance of real estate loans secured by nonfarm nonresidential properties, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans Secured by Farmland
entries.definition: Net losses on real estate loans secured by farmland divided by the outstanding balance of real estate loans secured by farmland, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.definition: Net losses on commercial and industrial loans divided by commercial and industrial loans, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Loans to Individuals
entries.definition: Net losses on consolidated loans to individuals divided by loans to individuals, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Credit Card Loans
entries.definition: Net losses on credit cards divided by the outstanding balance of credit card loans, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Agricultural Loans
entries.definition: Net losses on agricultural loans divided by agricultural loans, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Loans to Foreign Governments and Institutions
entries.definition: Net losses on loans to foreign governments and official institutions divided by loans to foreign governments and official institutions, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Other Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Net losses on other loans and leases divided by other loans and leases, gross of unearned income. entries.label: 30 Days and Over Past Due and Nonaccrual Assets
30 to 89 Days Past Due Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables on which either interest or principal is unpaid for 30 to 89 days and that are not required to be carried in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables on which either interest or principal is unpaid for 90 days or more, and that are not required to be carried in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: Nonaccrual Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables that are required to be reported on a nonaccrual basis because (a) they are maintained on a cash basis due to a deterioration in the financial position of the borrower, (b) payment in full of interest or principal is not expected, or (c) principal or interest has been in default for 90 days or longer, unless the obligation is both well secured and in the process of collection.

entries.label: Total Past Due and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The sum of loans and lease financing receivables that are 30 to 89 days past due and still accruing, 90 days or more past due and still accruing, and loans carried in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: Restructured Loans and Leases, 30 to 89 Days Past Due
entries.definition: Restructured or renegotiated loans and leases classified as 30 to 89 days past due.

entries.label: Restructured Loans and Leases, 90 Days and Over Past Due
entries.definition: Restructured or renegotiated loans and leases classified as 90 days or more past due.

entries.label: Restructured Loans and Leases, Nonaccrual
entries.definition: Restructured or renegotiated loans and leases in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: Total Restructured Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Restructured loans and lease financing receivables that are 30 days or more past due or in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due Loans Held for Sale
entries.definition: Loans and leases that are held for sale, at the lower of cost or fair value, on which interest or principal is unpaid for 30 to 89 days.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due Loans Held for Sale
entries.definition: Loans and leases that are held for sale, at the lower of cost or fair value, on which interest or principal is unpaid for 90 days or more.

entries.label: Nonaccrual Loans Held for Sale
entries.definition: Loans and leases that are held for sale, at the lower of cost or fair value, that are required to be reported on a nonaccrual basis.

entries.label: Total Past Due and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases Held for Sale
entries.definition: Total loans and leases held for sale that are 30 days or more past due plus total loans and leases held for sale that are required to be reported on a nonaccrual basis.

entries.label: Restructured Loans and Leases in Compliance
entries.definition: Loans and lease financing receivables that have been restructured or renegotiated because of a deterioration in the financial position of the obligor, but remain in compliance with the modified terms of the restructuring.

entries.label: Other Real Estate Owned
entries.definition: Other real estate owned.

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due
entries.definition: Assets (other than loans and leases, real estate owned, or other repossessed assets) including placements and debt securities on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due
entries.definition: Assets (other than loans and leases, real estate owned, or other repossessed assets) including placements and debt securities on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more.

entries.label: Nonaccrual
entries.definition: Assets (other than loans and leases, real estate owned, or other repossessed assets) including placements and debt securities that are in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: Total Other Assets 30 Days and Over Past Due and Nonaccrual
entries.definition: Assets (other than loans and leases, real estate owned or other repossessed assets) including placements and debt securities that are 30 days or more past due or in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and leases on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and leases on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Nonaccrual Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Loans and leases that are in nonaccrual status divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The sum of loans and leases on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more and loans and leases in nonaccrual status divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income. 88 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due Restructured Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Restructured or renegotiated loans and leases that are 30 to 89 days past due divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due Restructured Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Restructured or renegotiated loans and leases that are 90 days or more past due divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Nonaccrual Restructured Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Restructured or renegotiated loans and leases that are in nonaccrual status divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due Loans Held for Sale
entries.definition: Loans and leases held for sale on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due Loans Held for Sale
entries.definition: Loans held for sale on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Nonaccrual Loans Held for Sale
entries.definition: Loans and leases held for sale that are in nonaccrual status divided by loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Percent of Loans and Leases Plus Other Assets 30 Days and Over Past Due and Nonaccrual
30 to 89 Days Past Due Assets
entries.basis: Percent of Loans and Leases Plus Other Assets Over 30 Days Past Due or in Nonaccrual Status
entries.definition: Loans and leases and other assets on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by the sum of loans and leases, net of unearned income, and other assets that are 30 days or more past due and still accruing or carried in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due Assets
entries.basis: Percent of Loans and Leases Plus Other Assets Over 30 Days Past Due or in Nonaccrual Status
entries.definition: Loans and leases and other assets on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more divided by the sum of loans and leases, net of unearned income, and other assets that are 30 days or more past due and still accruing or carried in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: Nonaccrual Assets
entries.basis: Percent of Loans and Leases Plus Other Assets Over 30 Days Past Due or in Nonaccrual Status
entries.definition: Loans and leases and other assets that are in nonaccrual status divided by the sum of loans and leases, net of unearned income, and other assets that are 30 days or more past due and still accruing or carried in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: 30 Days and Over Past Due and Nonaccrual Assets
entries.basis: Percent of Loans and Leases Plus Other Assets Over 30 Days Past Due or in Nonaccrual Status
entries.definition: Loans and leases and other assets on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 days or more or that are in nonaccrual status divided by the sum of loans and leases, net of unearned income, and other assets that are 30 days or more past due and still accruing or carried in nonaccrual status.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due and Nonaccrual Assets
entries.definition: Loans and leases and other assets on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more or which are carried in nonaccrual status divided by total assets.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due and Nonaccrual Assets Plus Other Real Estate Owned
entries.definition: The sum of loans and leases and other assets on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more or which are carried in nonaccrual status and other real estate owned divided by total assets.

entries.label: Restructured and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases Plus Other Real Estate Owned
Total Assets
entries.basis: Restructured and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases Plus Other Real Estate Owned as a Percent of
entries.definition: The sum of restructured loans and leases that are 30 days or more past due, restructured loans in compliance with modified terms, loans and leases that are in nonaccrual status and other real estate owned divided by total assets.

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases
entries.basis: Restructured and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases Plus Other Real Estate Owned as a Percent of
entries.definition: The sum of restructured loans and leases that are 30 days or more past due, restructured loans in compliance with modified terms, loans and leases that are in nonaccrual status and other real estate owned divided by allowance for credit losses on loans and leases.

entries.label: Equity Capital Plus Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases
entries.basis: Restructured and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases Plus Other Real Estate Owned as a Percent of
entries.definition: The sum of restructured loans and leases that are 30 days or more past due, restructured loans in compliance with modified terms, loans and leases that are in nonaccrual status, and other real estate owned divided by the sum of equity capital plus allowance for credit losses on loans and leases.

entries.label: Tier 1 Capital Plus Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases
entries.basis: Restructured and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases Plus Other Real Estate Owned as a Percent of
entries.definition: The sum of restructured loans and leases that are 30 days or more past due, restructured loans in compliance with modified terms, loans and leases that are in nonaccrual status, and other real estate owned divided by the sum of tier 1 capital plus allowance for credit losses on loans and leases.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans Secured by 1–4 Family—90 Days and Over Past Due
entries.definition: Real estate loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties that are 90 days or more past due divided by real estate loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties, gross of unearned income.

entries.definition: Revolving open-end real estate loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties and extended under lines of credit that are 90 days or more past due divided by the outstanding balance of revolving open-end real estate loans secured by oneto four-family residential properties, gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Common Stock Plus Related Surplus
entries.definition: Common stock plus related surplus, net of treasury stock and unearned employee stock ownership plan shares.

entries.label: Retained Earnings
entries.definition: The amount of retained earnings as reported in Schedule HC-R. For a firm that has adopted ASU 2016-13 and has elected to apply the CECL transition provision, this amount is inclusive of the applicable portion of the CECL transitional amount, in accordance with section 301 of the regulatory capital rules.

entries.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (AOCI)
entries.definition: The amount of AOCI as reported under generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) that is included in Schedule HC, item 26(b).

entries.label: Common Equity Tier 1 Minority Interest
entries.definition: Common equity tier 1 minority interest includable in common tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Common Equity Tier 1 Capital Before Adjustments / Deductions
entries.definition: The sum of common stock plus related surplus, retained earnings, accumulated other comprehensive income, and common equity tier 1 minority interests.

entries.label: Common Equity Tier 1 Capital: Adjustments / Deductions
Less: Goodwill, Intangible Assets, and Deferred Tax Assets
entries.definition: Goodwill net of associated deferred tax liabilities, intangible assets net of associated deferred tax liabilities, and deferred tax assets that arise from net operating loss and tax credit carryforwards, net of any related valuation allowances and net of deferred tax liabilities.

entries.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income-Related Adjustments
entries.definition: Net unrealized gains (losses) on available-for-sale securities, net unrealized loss on available-for-sale equity exposures and preferred stock classified under GAAP as an equity security, accumulated net gains (losses) on cash flow hedges, AOCI attributable to defined benefit postretirement plans, unrealized gains (losses) on held-tomaturity securities, and accumulated net gain (loss) on cash flow hedges included in AOCI, net of applicable income taxes, that relate to the hedging of items that are not recognized at fair value on the balance sheet.

entries.label: Other Deductions from Common Equity Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: Other deductions (additions to) common equity tier 1 capital before threshold-based deductions, including unrealized net gain (loss) related to changes in the fair value of liabilities that are due to changes in own credit risk and all other deductions from (additions to) common equity tier 1 capital before threshold-based deductions. 102 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Subtotal
entries.definition: Common equity tier 1 capital before adjustments and deductions less goodwill, intangible assets, deferred tax assets, accumulated other comprehensive income-related adjustments, other deductions from common equity tier 1 capital, including non-significant investments.

entries.label: Other Adjustments & Deductions
entries.definition: Adjustments and deductions for common equity tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Common Equity Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: Common equity tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Additional Tier 1 Capital Instruments and Related Surplus
entries.definition: The portion of noncumulative perpetual preferred stock and related surplus that satisfy all the criteria in the regulatory capital rules of the Federal Reserve.

entries.label: Non-qualifying Capital Instruments
entries.definition: Non-qualifying capital instruments subject to phase out from additional tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Tier 1 Minority Interest Not Included in Common Equity Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: The amount of tier 1 minority interest not included in common equity tier 1 capital that is includable at the consolidated level.

entries.label: Additional Tier 1 Capital Before Deductions.
entries.definition: The sum of additional tier 1 capital instruments plus related surplus, non-qualifying capital instruments subject to phase out from additional tier 1 capital, and tier 1 minority interest not included in common equity tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Less: Additional Tier 1 Capital Deductions
entries.definition: The sum of investments in own additional tier 1 capital instruments, reciprocal cross-holdings in the capital of financial institutions, non-significant investments in additional tier 1 capital of unconsolidated financial institutions that exceed the 10 percent threshold for non-significant investments, significant investments in the capital of unconsolidated financial institutions not in the form of common stock to be deducted from additional tier 1 capital, and other adjustments and deductions.

entries.label: Additional Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: The greater of additional tier 1 capital before deductions minus additional tier 1 capital deductions, or zero.

entries.label: Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: The sum of common equity tier 1 capital and additional tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Tier 2 Capital Instruments and Related Surplus
entries.definition: Tier 2 capital instruments plus related surplus.

entries.label: Non-qualifying Capital Instruments
entries.definition: The total amount of non-qualifying capital instruments that were included in tier 2 capital and outstanding as of January 1, 2014, and that are subject to phase out.

entries.label: Total Capital Minority Interest Not Included in Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: The amount of total capital minority interest not included in tier 1 capital.

entries.label: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases in Tier 2 Capital
entries.definition: The portion of the holding company’s allowance for credit losses on loans and leases or adjusted allowance for credit losses that is includable in tier 2 capital. None of the holding company’s allocated transfer risk reserve, if any, is includable in tier 2 capital. The amount reported in this item cannot exceed 1.25 percent of the institution’s gross risk-weighted assets.

entries.label: Exited Advanced Approaches Eligible Credit Reserves
entries.definition: Advanced approaches holding companies that exit parallel run only: the amount of eligible credit reserves includable in tier 2 capital as reported in FFIEC 101 Schedule A.

entries.label: Unrealized Gains on Available-for-Sale Preferred Stock Classified as Equity
entries.definition: Unrealized gains on available-for-sale preferred stock classified as an equity security under GAAP and availablefor-sale equity exposures includable in tier 2 capital.

entries.label: Tier 2 Capital Before Deductions
entries.definition: The sum of tier 2 capital instruments plus related surplus, non-qualifying capital instruments, total capital minority interest not included in tier 1 capital, allowance for credit losses on loans and leases in tier 2 capital, and unrealized gains on available-for-sale preferred stock classified as equity.

entries.label: Exited Advanced Approaches Tier 2 Capital Before Deductions
entries.definition: Advanced approaches holding companies that exit parallel run only: the sum of tier 2 capital instruments plus related surplus, non-qualifying capital instruments, total capital minority interest not included in tier 1 capital, the amount of eligible credit reserves includable in tier 2 capital as reported in FFIEC 101 Schedule A for institutions that exit parallel run and unrealized gains on available-for-sale preferred stock classified as equity.

entries.label: Less: Tier 2 Capital Deductions
entries.definition: The sum of investments in own additional tier 2 capital instruments, reciprocal cross-holdings in the capital of financial institutions, non-significant investments in tier 2 capital of unconsolidated financial institutions that exceed the 10 percent threshold for non-significant investments, significant investments in the capital of unconsolidated financial institutions not in the form of common stock to be deducted from tier 2 capital, and other applicable adjustments and deductions applied to tier 2 capital in accordance with the Federal Reserve’s regulatory capital rules.

entries.label: Tier 2 Capital
entries.definition: The greater of tier 2 capital before deductions less tier 2 capital deductions, or zero.

entries.label: Exited Advanced Approaches Tier 2 Capital
entries.definition: Advanced approaches holding companies that exit parallel run only: the greater of exited advanced approach tier 2 capital before deductions less tier 2 capital deductions, or zero.

entries.label: Total Capital
entries.definition: The sum of tier 1 capital and tier 2 capital.

entries.label: Exited Advanced Approaches Total Capital
entries.definition: Advanced approaches holding companies that exit parallel run only: the sum of tier 1 capital and exited advanced approach tier 2 capital. 104 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Average Total Consolidated Assets
entries.definition: The amount of the quarterly average total consolidated assets as reported in Schedule HC-K or, for firms that have elected to apply the CECL transition provision, the applicable portion of the CECL transitional amount.

entries.label: Less: Deductions from Common Equity Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: The amounts deducted from common equity tier 1 capital and additional tier 1 capital in Schedule HC-R, Part 1.B., items 6, 7, 8, 10(b), 11, 13 through 17, and (elements of) item 24.

entries.label: Less: Other Deductions
entries.definition: The amount of any deductions from (additions to) total assets for leverage capital purposes that are not included in Schedule HC-R, item 37.

entries.label: Total Assets for Leverage Ratio
entries.definition: Schedule HC-R, item 36 less items 37 and 38.

entries.label: Total Risk-Weighted Assets
entries.definition: The amount of total risk-weighted assets using the general risk-based capital rules (as reported in Schedule HC-R, Part II, item 62), until December 31, 2014. Starting on January 1, 2015, report total risk-weighted assets calculated under the standardized approach in the regulatory capital rules (as reported in Schedule HC-R, Part II, item 31). From March 2020, a holding company that elects capital treatment under the CBLR framework does not report total risk-weighted assets (or its components).

entries.label: Exited Advanced Approaches Total RWA
entries.definition: Advanced approaches holding companies that exit parallel run only; the amount from FFIEC 101 Schedule A, item 60.

entries.label: Common Equity Tier 1 Capital, Column A
entries.definition: Common equity tier 1 capital divided by total risk-weighted assets. From March 2020, a holding company that elects capital treatment under the CBLR framework does not report this ratio.

entries.label: Common Equity Tier 1 Capital, Column B
entries.definition: Common equity tier 1 capital divided by exited advanced approaches total risk-weighted assets.

entries.label: Tier 1 Capital, Column A
entries.definition: Tier 1 capital divided by total risk-weighted assets. From March 2020, a holding company that elects capital treatment under the CBLR framework does not report this ratio.

entries.label: Tier 1 Capital, Column B
entries.definition: Tier 1 capital divided by exited advanced approaches total risk-weighted assets.

entries.label: Total Capital, Column A
entries.definition: Total capital divided by total risk-weighted assets. From March 2020, a holding company that elects capital treatment under the CBLR framework does not report this ratio.

entries.label: Total Capital, Column B
entries.definition: Total capital divided by exited advanced approaches total risk-weighted assets.

entries.label: Tier 1 Leverage
entries.definition: Tier 1 capital divided by total assets for the leverage ratio.
