entries.label: Total Insurance Underwriting Assets
entries.definition: The sum of total consolidated property and casualty and life and health assets that are specific to insurance underwriting activities of the holding company.

entries.label: Total Property and Casualty Assets
entries.definition: Total consolidated assets that are specific to property and casualty insurance underwriting activities of the holding company.

entries.label: Reinsurance Recoverables (P/C)
entries.definition: Total property and casualty insurance reinsurance recoverables from unaffiliated property and casualty reinsurers only. Completed only by holding companies with $10 million or more in reinsurance recoverables as of the effective date each quarter.

entries.label: Total Life and Health Assets
entries.definition: Total consolidated assets that are specific to life and health insurance underwriting activities of the holding company.

entries.label: Reinsurance Recoverables (L/H)
entries.definition: Total life and health insurance reinsurance recoverables from unaffiliated life and health reinsurers only. Completed only by holding companies with $10 million or more in reinsurance recoverables as of the effective date each quarter.

entries.label: Separate Account Assets (L/H)
entries.definition: Life and health assets qualifying for separate account summary total presentation in the balance sheet, including assets related to products in which the contractholder and not the insurer retains all or most of the investment and/or interest rate risk.

entries.label: Total Insurance Underwriting Equity
entries.definition: The sum of total consolidated equity capital of property and casualty and life and health underwriting subsidiaries that are consolidated under GAAP.

entries.label: Total Property and Casualty Equity
entries.definition: Total equity capital of property and casualty underwriting subsidiaries that are consolidated under GAAP.

entries.label: Total Life and Health Equity
entries.definition: Total equity capital of life and health underwriting subsidiaries that are consolidated under GAAP.

entries.label: Total Insurance Underwriting Net Income
entries.definition: Consolidated net income attributable to property and casualty and life and health insurance underwriting related activities of the holding company.

entries.label: Total Property and Casualty
entries.definition: Consolidated net income attributable to property and casualty insurance underwriting related activities of the holding company. 108 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Total Life and Health
entries.definition: Consolidated net income attributable to life and health insurance underwriting related activities of the holding company.

entries.label: Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense Reserves (P/C)
entries.definition: The liability for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense reserves, which represents the estimated ultimate cost of settling property and casualty claims, net of estimated recoveries, and including all costs expected to be incurred in connection with the settlement of unpaid claims.

entries.label: Unearned Premiums (P/C)
entries.definition: The reserve for unearned property and casualty premiums. Unearned premiums represent the policy premiums associated with the unexpired portion of the term of coverage.

entries.label: Policyholder Benefits and Contractholder Funds (L/H)
entries.definition: The liability for future life and health policy benefits, which represents the present value of future policy benefits to be paid to or on the behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums. This item also includes contractholder funds that represent receipts from the issuance of universal life, corporate owned life insurance, pension investment, and certain deferred annuity contracts.

entries.label: Separate Account Liabilities (L/H)
entries.definition: All life and health liabilities qualifying for separate account summary presentation in the insurer’s balance sheet.

entries.label: Insurance Activities Revenue
entries.definition: The amount of other insurance activities income plus insurance and reinsurance underwriting income.

entries.label: Other Insurance Activities Income
entries.definition: Income from other insurance activities.

entries.label: Insurance and Reinsurance Underwriting Income
entries.definition: Underwriting income from insurance and reinsurance activities.

entries.label: Premiums
entries.definition: The sum of premiums on insurance related to the extension of credit and all other insurance premiums.

entries.label: Credit-Related Insurance Underwriting Premiums
entries.definition: Premiums on insurance related to the extension of credit.

entries.label: Other Insurance Underwriting Premiums
entries.definition: All other insurance premiums from other insurance and reinsurance underwriting other than the credit-related insurance premiums. Exclude all insurance and annuity sales and referral fee revenue.

entries.label: Insurance Benefits, Losses, Expenses
entries.definition: The current and future benefits, losses, and expenses from insurance-related activities.

entries.label: Net Assets of Insurance Underwriting Subsidiaries
entries.definition: This item includes only the net assets of a financial holding company’s insurance underwriting subsidiaries that engage in insurance underwriting activities that have been authorized by the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act. (Excludes intercompany assets and claims on affiliates that are eliminated when preparing consolidated statements. Also excludes any subsidiaries that are held through a U.S. depository institution.)

entries.label: Life Insurance Assets
entries.definition: The sum of general account life insurance assets, separate account life insurance assets, and hybrid account life insurance assets.

entries.label: Insurance Underwriting Assets / Consolidated Assets
entries.definition: The sum of total consolidated property and casualty and life and health assets that are specific to insurance underwriting activities of the holding company divided by consolidated assets.

entries.label: Insurance Underwriting Assets (P/C) / Total Insurance Underwriting Assets
entries.definition: Total consolidated assets that are specific to property and casualty insurance underwriting activities for the holding company divided by total insurance underwriting assets.

entries.label: Insurance Underwriting Assets (L/H) / Total Insurance Underwriting Assets
entries.definition: Total consolidated assets that are specific to life and health insurance underwriting activities of the holding company divided by total insurance underwriting assets.

entries.label: Separate Account Assets (L/H) / Total Life Assets
entries.definition: Life and health assets qualifying for separate account summary total presentation in the balance sheet, including assets related to products in which the contractholder and not the insurer retains all or most of the investment and/or interest rate risk, divided by total life and health underwriting assets.

entries.label: Insurance Activities Revenue / Adjusted Operating Income
entries.definition: The amount of insurance and reinsurance underwriting income plus other insurance and reinsurance activities income, divided by adjusted tax equivalent operating income. Tax equivalent income information is not calculated for a holding company that is exempt from reporting Schedule HI Memorandum Items 1 and 2. (See Tax Equivalency in section 2.)

entries.label: Premium Income / Insurance Activities Revenue
entries.definition: The sum of total credit-related insurance underwriting premiums and other insurance underwriting premiums divided by total insurance activities revenue.

entries.label: Credit-Related Premium Income / Total Premium Income
entries.definition: Premiums on insurance related to the extension of credit divided by total premium income.

entries.label: Other Premium Income / Total Premium Income
entries.definition: Insurance premiums that were earned by property and casualty and health insurers, or written by life insurers, other than premiums earned on credit life and mortgage insurance divided by total premium income.

entries.label: Insurance Underwriting Net Income / Consolidated Net Income
entries.definition: Consolidated net income attributable to property and casualty and life and health insurance underwriting related activities of the holding company divided by consolidated net income of the holding company.

entries.label: Insurance Underwriting Net Income (P/C) / Equity (P/C)
entries.definition: Consolidated net income attributable to property and casualty insurance underwriting related activities of the holding company divided by total property and casualty insurance underwriting subsidiary equity capital.

entries.label: Insurance Underwriting Net Income (L/H) / Equity (L/H)
entries.definition: Consolidated net income attributable to life and health insurance underwriting related activities of the holding company divided by total life and health insurance underwriting subsidiary equity capital.

entries.label: Insurance Benefits, Losses, and Expenses / Insurance Premiums
entries.definition: The current and future benefits, losses, and expenses from insurance-related activities divided by total insurance premiums. 110 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Reinsurance Recoverables (P/C) / Total Assets (P/C)
entries.definition: Total property and casualty insurance subsidiary reinsurance recoverables from unaffiliated property and casualty reinsurers only divided by total property and casualty insurance underwriting subsidiary assets.

entries.label: Reinsurance Recoverables (L/H) / Total Assets (L/H)
entries.definition: Total life and health insurance subsidiary reinsurance recoverables from unaffiliated life and health reinsurers only divided by total life and health insurance underwriting subsidiary assets.

entries.label: Net Assets of FHC Insurance Underwriting Subsidiaries / Consolidated Assets
entries.definition: The consolidated net assets of a financial holding company’s insurance underwriting subsidiaries that engage in insurance underwriting activities that have been authorized by the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act divided by total consolidated assets of the holding company.

entries.label: Life Insurance Assets / Tier 1 Capital + Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases
entries.basis: Tier 1 Capital + Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Life insurance assets divided by tier 1 capital (from Schedule HC-R, Part 1.A for non-Advanced Approaches institutions and Schedule HC-R, Part 1.B for Advanced Approaches institutions) plus the allowance for credit losses on loans and leases.

entries.label: Net Assets of Broker-Dealer Subsidiaries ($000)
entries.definition: Net assets of a holding company’s broker-dealer subsidiaries that engage in underwriting or dealing securities pursuant to the Bank Holding Company Act as amended by the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act. (Excludes intercompany assets and claims on affiliates that are eliminated when preparing consolidated statements. Also excludes any subsidiaries that are held through a U.S. depository institution.)

entries.label: Net Assets of Broker-Dealer Subs / Consolidated Assets
entries.definition: Net assets of a holding company’s broker-dealer subsidiaries that engage in underwriting or dealing securities pursuant to the Bank Holding Company Act as amended by the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act divided by total consolidated assets. entries.label: Total Foreign Loans
entries.definition: The sum of real estate loans to non-U.S. addressees, loans to non-U.S. depository institutions, loans to foreign banks, loans to foreign governments and official institutions, loans to individuals in foreign offices, foreign agricultural loans, other loans in foreign offices, and foreign lease financing receivables. Amounts are reported gross of unearned income.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans
entries.definition: Loans secured by real estate to non-U.S. addressees. Prior to March 31, 2001, this item reflects consolidated real estate loans minus domestic real estate loans.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.definition: Loans for commercial and industrial purposes to non-U.S. addressees which are sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises.

entries.label: Loans to Depository Institutions
entries.definition: Loans to U.S. and foreign branches of banks chartered and headquartered in a foreign country.

entries.label: Loans to Foreign Governments and Institutions
entries.definition: Loans to governments in foreign countries, to their official institutions, and to international and regional official institutions.

entries.label: Loans to Individuals
entries.definition: Consolidated loans to individuals minus domestic loans to individuals.

entries.label: Agricultural Loans
entries.definition: Consolidated agricultural loans minus domestic agricultural loans.

entries.label: Other Foreign Loans
entries.definition: Consolidated other loans minus domestic other loans.

entries.label: Lease Financing Receivables
entries.definition: Outstanding receivable balances related to direct financing and leases on property acquired for leasing to non-U.S. addresses.

entries.label: Debt Securities
entries.definition: Debt securities issued by non-U.S. chartered corporations, foreign governments, or special international organizations. These securities are valued at amortized cost if classified as held-to-maturity or at fair value if classified as available-for-sale.

entries.label: Interest-Bearing Bank Balances
entries.definition: Total interest-bearing balances due from depository institutions and foreign central banks that are held in the holding company’s foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, IBFs, or consolidated subsidiaries located outside the 50 states of the United States and the District of Columbia.

entries.label: Total Selected Foreign Assets
entries.definition: The sum of foreign loans and leases, foreign debt securities, and interest-bearing balances in foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, and IBFs.

entries.label: Total Foreign Deposits
entries.definition: Foreign interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing deposits.

entries.label: Interest-Bearing Deposits
entries.definition: Interest-bearing deposits in foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, and IBFs.

entries.label: Non-Interest-Bearing Deposits
entries.definition: Non-interest-bearing deposits in foreign offices, Edge or Agreement subsidiaries, and IBFs.

entries.label: Real Estate Loans
entries.basis: Net Losses as a Percent of
entries.definition: Charge-offs less recoveries on real estate loans to non-U.S. addressees (annualized) divided by real estate loans to non-U.S. addresses.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.basis: Net Losses as a Percent of
entries.definition: Charge-offs less recoveries on commercial and industrial loans to non-U.S. addresses (annualized) divided by commercial and industrial loans to non-U.S. addresses.

entries.label: Foreign Governments and Institutions
entries.definition: Charge-offs less recoveries on loans to foreign governments and institutions (annualized) divided by loans to foreign governments and institutions.

section: Servicing, Securitization, and Asset Sale Activities—Part 1

entries.label: 1–4 Family Residential Loans
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of closed-end loans secured by first or junior liens on oneto four-family residential properties that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements.

entries.label: Home Equity Lines
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of revolving, open-end lines of credit secured by oneto four-family residential properties that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements.

entries.label: Credit Card Receivables
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of extensions of credit to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures arising from credit cards that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements.

entries.label: Auto Loans
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of loans to individuals for the purpose of purchasing private passenger vehicles, including minivans, sport-utility vehicles, pickup trucks, and similar light trucks for personal use that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of loans for commercial and industrial purposes to sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises, whether secured (other than by real estate) or unsecured, single payment or installment, that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements.

entries.label: All Other Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of all other loans that cannot properly be reported in other categories, and all lease financing receivables that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements.

entries.label: 1–4 Family Residential Loans
entries.definition: The unused portions of standby letters of credit, subordinated securities, and maximum contractual amounts of recourse or other credit exposures arising from credit enhancements that the holding company has provided for securitized closed-end loans secured by first or junior liens on oneto four-family residential properties, excluding retained credit-enhancing interest-only strips.

entries.label: Home Equity Lines
entries.definition: The unused portions of standby letters of credit, subordinated securities, and maximum contractual amounts of recourse or other credit exposures arising from credit enhancements that the holding company has provided for securitized revolving, open-end lines of credit secured by oneto four-family residential properties, excluding retained credit-enhancing interest-only strips.

entries.label: Credit Card Receivables
entries.definition: The unused portions of standby letters of credit, subordinated securities, and maximum contractual amounts of recourse or other credit exposures arising from credit enhancements that the holding company has provided for securitized extensions of credit to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures arising from credit cards, excluding retained credit-enhancing interest-only strips.

entries.label: Auto Loans
entries.definition: The unused portions of standby letters of credit, subordinated securities, and maximum contractual amounts of recourse or other credit exposures arising from credit enhancements that the holding company has provided for securitized loans for the purpose of purchasing private passenger vehicles, including minivans, sport-utility vehicles, pickup trucks, and similar light trucks for personal use, excluding retained credit-enhancing interestonly strips.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.definition: The unused portions of standby letters of credit, subordinated securities, and maximum contractual amounts of recourse or other credit exposures arising from credit enhancements that the holding company has provided for securitized loans for commercial and industrial purposes to sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises, whether secured (other than by real estate) or unsecured, single payment or installment, excluding retained credit-enhancing interest-only strips.

entries.label: All Other Loans and Leases
entries.definition: The unused portions of standby letters of credit, subordinated securities, and maximum contractual amounts of recourse or other credit exposures arising from credit enhancements that the holding company has provided for all other securitized loans that cannot properly be reported in other categories, and all securitized lease financing receivables.

entries.label: Total Retained Credit Exposure
entries.definition: The sum of total retained interest-only strips and other retained credit enhancements provided by the holding company to the securitization structures reported in schedule HC-S, item 1, of the FR Y-9C report.

entries.definition: Net losses on the outstanding principal balance of closed-end loan secured by first or junior liens on oneto four-family residential properties that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements divided by the outstanding principal balance of securitized oneto four-family residential loans.

entries.label: Home Equity Lines
entries.definition: Net losses on the outstanding principal balance of revolving, open-end lines of credit secured by oneto four-family residential properties that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other sellerprovided credit enhancements divided by the outstanding principal balance of securitized home equity lines.

entries.label: Credit Card Receivables
entries.definition: Net losses on the outstanding principal balance of extensions of credit to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures arising from credit cards that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements divided by the outstanding principal balance of securitized credit card receivables.

entries.label: Auto Loans
entries.definition: Net losses on the outstanding principal balance of loans to individuals for the purpose of purchasing private passenger vehicles, including minivans, sport-utility vehicles, pickup trucks, and similar light trucks for personal use that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements divided by the outstanding principal balance of securitized auto loans.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.definition: Net losses on the outstanding principal balance of loans for commercial and industrial purposes to sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises, whether secured (other than by real estate) or unsecured, single payment or installment, that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse divided by the outstanding principal balance of securitized commercial and industrial loans.

entries.label: All Other Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Net losses on the outstanding principal balance of all other loans that cannot properly be reported in other categories and all lease financing receivables that have been sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements divided by the outstanding principal balance of all other loans that cannot properly be reported in other categories and all lease financing receivables that have been securitized.

entries.label: Total Net Losses on Securitized Assets
entries.definition: Net losses on the sum of outstanding principal balances of all assets sold and securitized with servicing retained or with recourse or other seller-provided credit enhancements divided by the sum of outstanding principal balances of all securitized assets.

entries.label: 30 to 89 Days Past Due Managed Assets as a Percent of Type
1–4 Family Residential Loans—30 to 89 Days Past Due
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of managed closed-end loans secured by first or junior liens on oneto four-family residential properties on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed oneto four-family loans. 128 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Home Equity Lines—30 to 89 Days Past Due
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of managed revolving, open-end lines of credit secured by oneto four-family residential properties on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed home equity loans.

entries.label: Credit Card Receivables—30 to 89 Days Past Due
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of managed extensions of credit to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures arising from credit cards on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed credit card receivables.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans—30 to 89 Days Past Due
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of managed loans for commercial and industrial purposes to sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises, whether secured (other than by real estate) or unsecured, single payment or installment, on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed commercial and industrial loans.

entries.label: All Other Loans and Leases—30 to 89 Days Past Due
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of all other managed loans and leases, including auto loans, that cannot properly be reported in other categories, on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by the outstanding principal balance of all managed loans and leases that cannot properly be reported in other categories.

entries.label: Total Managed Loans Past Due 30 to 89 Days
entries.definition: The sum of outstanding principal balances of all managed assets, net of unearned income, on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 30 to 89 days divided by total managed loans and leases.

entries.label: 90 Days and Over Past Due Managed Assets as a Percent of Type
1–4 Family Residential Loans—Past Due 90 Days and Over
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of managed closed-end loans secured by first or junior liens on oneto four-family residential properties on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed oneto four-family loans.

entries.label: Home Equity Lines—Past Due 90 Days and Over
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of managed revolving, open-end lines of credit secured by oneto four-family residential properties on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed home equity loans.

entries.label: Credit Card Receivables—Past Due 90 Days and Over
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of managed extensions of credit to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures arising from credit cards on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed credit card receivables.

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans—Past Due 90 Days and Over
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of managed loans for commercial and industrial purposes to sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises, whether secured (other than by real estate) or unsecured, single payment or installment, on which interest or principal is due and unpaid 90 days or more divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed commercial and industrial loans.

entries.label: All Other Loans and Leases—Past Due 90 Days and Over
entries.definition: Outstanding principal balance of all other managed loans and leases, including auto loans, that cannot properly be reported in other categories, on which interest principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more divided by the outstanding principal balance of all managed loans and leases that cannot properly be reported in other categories.

entries.label: Total Managed Loans—Past Due 90 Days and Over
entries.definition: The sum of outstanding principal balances of all managed assets, net of unearned income, on which interest or principal is due and unpaid for 90 days or more divided by managed loans and leases.

entries.label: Net Losses on Managed Assets as a Percent of Type
1–4 Family Residential Loans
entries.definition: Annualized net losses on the outstanding principal balance of managed closed-end loans secured by first or junior liens on oneto four-family residential properties divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed oneto four-family loans. (See Annualization in section 2.)

entries.label: Home Equity Lines
entries.definition: Annualized net losses on the outstanding principal balance of managed revolving, open-end lines of credit secured by oneto four-family residential properties divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed home equity lines. (See Annualization in section 2.)

entries.label: Credit Card Receivables
entries.definition: Annualized net losses on the outstanding principal balance of managed extensions of credit to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures arising from credit cards divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed credit card receivables. (See Annualization in section 2.)

entries.label: Commercial and Industrial Loans
entries.definition: Annualized net losses on the outstanding principal balance of managed loans for commercial and industrial purposes to sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations, and other business enterprises, whether secured (other than by real estate) or unsecured, single payment or installment, divided by the outstanding principal balance of managed commercial and industrial loans. (See Annualization in section 2.)

entries.label: All Other Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Annualized net losses on the outstanding principal balance of all other managed loans and leases, including auto loans, that cannot properly be reported in other categories, divided by the outstanding principal balance of all managed loans and leases that cannot properly be reported in other categories. (See Annualization in section 2.)

entries.label: Net Losses on Managed Assets as a Percentage of Total Managed Assets
Operating Income
entries.definition: Total income (dividend income, interest income, management and service fees, and other income) from direct investments in and transactions with direct and indirect bank subsidiaries and associated banks, excluding equity in undistributed income.

entries.label: Income from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Total income (dividend income, interest income, management and service fees, and other income) from direct investments in and transactions with direct and indirect bank subsidiaries and associated banks, excluding equity in undistributed income.

entries.label: Dividends
entries.definition: Dividend income declared or paid to the holding company by bank subsidiaries and associated banks.

entries.label: Interest
entries.definition: Interest income to the holding company on extensions of credit to, and paid or payable by, bank subsidiaries and associated banks.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees
entries.definition: Management and service fees to the holding company in connection with services rendered to, and paid or payable by, bank subsidiaries and associated banks.

entries.label: Other Income
entries.definition: All other income to the holding company that relates to transactions with, and paid or payable by, bank subsidiaries and associated banks.

entries.label: Income from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Total income (dividend income, interest income, management and service fees, and other income) from direct investments in and transactions with direct and indirect nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies, excluding equity in undistributed income and income from banks, subsidiaries of banks, and Edge and Agreement subsidiaries.

entries.label: Dividends
entries.definition: Dividend income declared or paid to the holding company by nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies. 132 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Interest
entries.definition: Interest income to the holding company on extensions of credit to, and paid or payable by, nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees
entries.definition: Management and service fees to the holding company in connection with services rendered to, and paid or payable by, nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Other Income
entries.definition: All other income to the holding company that relates to transactions with, and paid or payable by, nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Income from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: Total income (dividend income, interest income, management and service fees, and other income) from direct investments in and transactions with direct and indirect subsidiary holding companies and associated holding companies, excluding equity in undistributed income.

entries.label: Dividends
entries.definition: Dividend income declared or paid to the holding company by holding company subsidiaries and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Interest
entries.definition: Interest income to the holding company on extensions of credit to, and paid or payable by, holding company subsidiaries and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees
entries.definition: Management and service fees to the holding company in connection with services rendered to, and paid or payable by, holding company subsidiaries and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Other Income
entries.definition: All other income to the holding company that relates to transactions with, and paid or payable by, holding company subsidiaries and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Total Income from Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The sum of dividend income, interest income, management and service fees, and other income received from bank, nonbank, and holding company subsidiaries.

entries.label: Securities Gains
entries.definition: The net gain or loss realized from the sale, exchange, redemption, or retirement of securities.

entries.label: Other Operating Income
entries.definition: All other operating income, excluding income from subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Total Operating Income
entries.definition: The sum of total income from subsidiaries, securities gains (losses), and other operating income.

entries.label: Personnel Expenses
entries.definition: Expenses on salaries, wages of officers and employees, pensions, and employee benefits.

entries.label: Interest Expense
entries.definition: Interest expense on all debt instruments issued by the holding company.

entries.label: Other Expenses
entries.definition: All other operating expenses of the holding company including amortization of intangible assets.

entries.label: Provision for Credit Losses on Financial Assets
entries.definition: The year-to-date provision for credit losses on financial assets.

entries.label: Total Operating Expenses
entries.definition: The sum of personnel expenses, interest expense, other expenses, and the provision for loan and lease losses, including the provision for allocated transfer risk.

entries.label: Income (Loss) before Taxes
entries.definition: Total operating income minus total operating expenses.

entries.label: Applicable Income Taxes (Credit)
entries.definition: The estimated amount of current and deferred income taxes, federal, state, and local (estimated or accrued) on a parent company only basis.

entries.label: Extraordinary Items
entries.definition: The net amount of extraordinary items less applicable taxes including non-operating items.

entries.label: Income before Undistributed Income of Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The sum of income before taxes and extraordinary items minus applicable income taxes.

entries.label: Equity in Undistributed Income of Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The parent company’s equity in the undistributed income of bank, nonbank, and holding company subsidiaries less applicable taxes.

entries.label: Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The parent company’s equity in the undistributed income of bank subsidiaries, Edge and Agreement subsidiaries, and associated banks less applicable taxes.

entries.label: Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The parent company’s equity in the undistributed income of nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies less applicable taxes.

entries.label: Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: The parent company’s equity in the undistributed income of holding company subsidiaries and associated holding companies less applicable taxes.

entries.label: Net Income (Loss)
entries.definition: Income (loss) before undistributed income of subsidiaries and associated companies plus equity in undistributed income of subsidiaries and associated companies. 134 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Bank Net Income
entries.definition: Dividends from bank subsidiaries and associated banks plus equity in undistributed income of bank subsidiaries, Edge and Agreement subsidiaries, and associated banks.

entries.label: Nonbank Net Income
entries.definition: Dividends from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies plus equity in undistributed income of nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Investment in Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The sum of equity investments in bank subsidiaries and associated banks and nonequity investments in and receivables due from bank subsidiaries and associated banks.

entries.label: Common and Preferred Stock
entries.definition: Investments in the common stock and preferred stock (including surplus) of bank subsidiaries and associated banks excluding unamortized goodwill or other intangible assets.

entries.label: Excess of Cost over Fair Value
entries.definition: The sum of unamortized goodwill and specifically identifiable intangible assets that are related to the acquisition of subsidiary banks and associated banks.

entries.label: Loans, Advances, Notes, and Bonds
entries.definition: All assets of the holding company that represent extensions of credit to directly or indirectly held bank subsidiaries and associated banks and investments in debt instruments issued by bank subsidiaries and associated banks.

entries.label: Other Receivables
entries.definition: All other assets that represent claims of the holding company on bank subsidiaries and associated banks.

entries.label: Investment in Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The sum of equity investments in nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies and nonequity investments in and receivables due from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Common and Preferred Stock
entries.definition: Investments in the common stock and preferred stock (including surplus) of nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies excluding unamortized goodwill or other intangible assets.

entries.label: Excess of Cost over Fair Value
entries.definition: The sum of unamortized goodwill and specifically identifiable intangible assets that are related to the acquisition of nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Loans, Advances, Notes, and Bonds
entries.definition: All assets of the holding company that represent extensions of credit to (directly or indirectly held) nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies, and investments in debt instruments issued by nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Other Receivables
entries.definition: All other assets that represent claims of the holding company on nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Investment in Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: The sum of equity investments in subsidiary holding companies and non-equity investments in, and receivables due from, subsidiary and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Common and Preferred Stock
entries.definition: Investments in the common stock and preferred stock (including surplus) of holding company subsidiaries and associated holding companies excluding unamortized goodwill or other intangible assets.

entries.label: Excess of Cost over Fair Value
entries.definition: The sum of unamortized goodwill and specifically identifiable intangible assets that are related to the acquisition of subsidiary and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Loans, Advances, Notes, and Bonds
entries.definition: All assets of the holding company that represent extensions of credit to (directly or indirectly held) holding company subsidiaries and associated holding companies and investments in debt instruments issued by holding company subsidiaries, and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Other Receivables
entries.definition: All other assets that represent claims of the holding company on subsidiary and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Net Loans and Leases
entries.definition: Extensions of credit, net of unearned income, resulting from either direct negotiation between the holding company and its customers or the purchase of such assets from others.

entries.label: Securities
entries.definition: U.S. Treasury securities, obligations of other U.S. government agencies and corporations, obligations of other states and political subdivisions, and other debt and equity securities, excluding investments in subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Securities Purchased (Reverse Repos)
entries.definition: Securities purchased under agreements to resell other than securities purchased under resale agreements to maturity.

entries.label: Cash and Balances Due from Affiliated Depository Institutions
entries.definition: All currency and coin, demand, time and savings balances, and other cash items due from or held with subsidiary or affiliated depository institutions.

entries.label: Cash and Balances Due from Unrelated Depository Institutions
entries.definition: All currency and coin, demand, time and savings balances, and other cash items due from or held with unrelated depository institutions.

entries.label: Premises, Furniture, Fixtures and Equipment
entries.definition: The book value, net of depreciation, of all premises, furniture, fixtures, and equipment. 138 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Intangible Assets
entries.definition: The sum of mortgage servicing assets, goodwill, and other identifiable intangible assets.

entries.label: Other Assets
entries.definition: All other assets including income earned, but not collected, and deferred income taxes (debit balance).

entries.label: Balances Due from Subsidiaries and Related Institutions
entries.definition: All balances due from subsidiaries and related institutions, other than investments and receivables.

entries.label: Total Assets
entries.definition: Total parent company assets, which include investments in subsidiaries, loans and leases (net of unearned income, allowance for credit losses on loans and leases, and allocated transfer risk reserve), securities, federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell, cash and due from depository institutions, premises, furniture and fixtures, intangible and other assets, and balances due from subsidiaries and affiliated holding companies.

entries.label: Deposits
entries.definition: Deposits issued by the parent company.

entries.label: Securities Sold (Repos)
entries.definition: Securities sold under agreements to repurchase other than securities sold under repurchase agreements to maturity.

entries.label: Commercial Paper
entries.definition: Outstanding commercial paper issued by the holding company to unrelated parties.

entries.label: Other Borrowings with Maturity of 1 Year or Less
entries.definition: The amount of money borrowed by the holding company with a remaining maturity of one year or less.

entries.label: Borrowings with Maturity over 1 Year
entries.definition: The amount of money borrowed by the holding company with a remaining maturity of more than one year.

entries.label: Subordinated Notes and Debentures
entries.definition: Subordinated debt issued by the holding company or its subsidiaries. This line item includes subordinated perpetual debt, limited-life preferred stock and related surplus, and outstanding equity contract and commitment notes that qualify as capital, as defined by the Federal Reserve Board’s capital adequacy guidelines.

entries.label: Other Liabilities
entries.definition: All other liabilities including expenses accrued and unpaid and deferred income taxes (credit balance).

entries.label: Balances Due to Subsidiaries and Related Institutions
entries.definition: All balances due to subsidiaries and related institutions including shortand long-term borrowings, accrued interest payable, and taxes payable.

entries.label: Total Liabilities
entries.definition: The sum of deposits, commercial paper and other borrowings with a remaining maturity of one year or less, other borrowed funds with a remaining maturity of greater than one year, subordinated notes and debentures, other liabilities, and balances due to other subsidiaries and related institutions.

entries.label: Equity Capital
entries.definition: The sum of perpetual preferred stock (including related surplus), common stock, common surplus, retained earnings, accumulated other comprehensive income, and other equity capital components minus treasury stock.

entries.label: Perpetual Preferred Stock (Including Surplus)
entries.definition: The aggregate par or stated value of all outstanding perpetual preferred stock including any amounts received in excess of its par or stated value.

entries.label: Common Stock
entries.definition: The aggregate par or stated value of outstanding common stock.

entries.label: Common Surplus
entries.definition: The net amount formally transferred to the surplus account including capital contributions and any amount received for common stock in excess of its par or stated value.

entries.label: Retained Earnings
entries.definition: The amount of retained earnings, including capital reserves, that result from the transfer of net income, declaration of dividends, transfers to surplus, or other appropriate entries.

entries.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income
entries.definition: The amount of other comprehensive income in conformity with ASC subtopic 220-10, Comprehensive Income— Overall (formerly the requirements of FASB Statement No. 130, Reporting Comprehensive Income). Other comprehensive income includes net unrealized holding gains (losses) on available-for-sale securities, accumulated net gains (losses) on cash flow hedges, foreign currency translation adjustments, and minimum pension liability adjustments. From March 31, 1999, to December 31, 2000, this item includes net unrealized holding gains (losses) on available-for-sale securities, accumulated net gains (losses) reported on cash flow hedges, and foreign currency translation adjustments. Prior to March 31, 1999, accumulated net gains (losses) on cash flow hedges were not reported on the FR Y-9LP and are not included in this item.

entries.label: Other Equity Capital Components
entries.definition: The amount of all other equity capital components, including unearned Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) shares and the carrying value, at cost, of treasury stock.

entries.label: Total Liabilities and Equity Capital
entries.definition: Total liabilities and equity capital as reported in Schedule PC of the FR Y-9LP.

entries.label: Loans and Advances from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The amount of borrowings of the parent company from subsidiary banks and associated banks and Edge and Agreement subsidiaries.

entries.label: Loans and Advances from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The amount of borrowings of the parent company from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Notes Payable to Subsidiaries That Have Issued Trust Preferred Securities
entries.definition: The amount of notes payable by the parent holding company to special purpose subsidiaries that have issued trust preferred securities.

entries.label: Loans and Advances from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: The amount of borrowings of the parent company from holding company subsidiaries and associated holding companies.

entries.label: Subordinated and Long-Term Debt Maturing in 1 Year or Less
entries.definition: The amount of liabilities (included in mandatory convertible securities, subordinated notes and debentures, and balances due to subsidiaries and related institutions) that are scheduled to mature within one year. 140 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Subsidiary Borrowings Guaranteed by the Parent Holding Company Guaranteed Loans to Banks, Nonbanks, and Holding Companies
entries.definition: The amount of borrowings of subsidiaries from unaffiliated parties for which the parent holding company has guaranteed subsidiary performance or has otherwise assumed any risk of loss. entries.label: Net Income / Average Equity Capital
entries.definition: Net income divided by average equity capital. Net income for Subchapter S filers is adjusted downward by an assumed federal tax rate of 21 percent (35 percent prior to 2018). Average equity capital is the cumulative sum of the quarterly average consolidated equity capital, excluding limited-life preferred stock (as reported in Schedule HC-K of the FR Y-9C report) for calendar quarters to date (four-point average). (See Average Balances in section 2.)

entries.label: Bank Net Income / Average Equity Investment in Bank Subsidiaries
entries.basis: Average Equity Investment in Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The sum of dividends from bank subsidiaries and associated banks and equity in undistributed income of bank subsidiaries and associated banks divided by average equity investments in bank subsidiaries and associated banks.

entries.label: Nonbank Net Income / Average Equity Investment in Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.basis: Average Equity Investment in Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: The sum of dividends from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies and equity in undistributed income of nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies divided by average equity investments in nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies.

entries.label: Subsidiary Holding Companies’ Net Income / Average Equity Investment in Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.basis: Average Equity Investment in Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: The sum of dividends from subsidiary holding companies and equity in undistributed income of subsidiary holding companies divided by average equity investments in subsidiary holding companies.

entries.label: Bank Net Income / Parent Net Income
entries.definition: The sum of dividends from banks and equity in undistributed income of bank subsidiaries and associated banks divided by parent company net income.

entries.label: Subsidiary Holding Companies’ Net Income / Parent Net Income
entries.definition: The sum of dividends from subsidiary holding companies and equity in undistributed income of subsidiary holding companies divided by parent company net income.

entries.label: Total Liabilities / Equity Capital
entries.definition: The sum of deposits, securities sold under agreements to repurchase, commercial paper, other borrowings with a remaining maturity of one year or less, other borrowed funds with a remaining maturity of greater than one year, subordinated notes and debentures (including limited-life preferred stock and related surplus), balances due to subsidiaries and other related institutions, and other liabilities divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: Total Debt / Equity Capital
entries.definition: The sum of commercial paper, other borrowings with a remaining maturity of one year or less, borrowed funds with a remaining maturity of greater than one year, and subordinated notes and debentures (including limited-life preferred stock and related surplus), divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: Total Debt Plus Notes Payable to Subsidiaries That Have Issued Trust Preferred Securities / Total Equity Capital
entries.definition: Total debt of the parent holding company plus notes payable to subsidiaries that have issued trust preferred securities divided by total equity capital of the parent holding company.

entries.label: Total Debt Plus Loans Guaranteed for Affiliates / Equity Capital
entries.definition: Total debt of the parent holding company plus guaranteed loans of subsidiary banks, nonbanks, and holding companies divided by total equity capital of the parent holding company.

entries.label: Total Debt / Equity Capital Less Excess of Cost over Fair Value
entries.basis: Equity Capital Less Excess of Cost over Fair Value
entries.definition: The sum of commercial paper, borrowings with a remaining maturity of one year or less, borrowed funds with a remaining maturity of greater than one year, and subordinated notes and debentures (including limited-life preferred stock and related surplus), divided by parent company equity capital minus the excess of cost over fair value (goodwill plus other intangible assets).

entries.label: Long-Term Debt / Equity Capital
entries.definition: The sum of other borrowed funds with a remaining maturity of greater than one year, and subordinated notes and debentures (including limited-life preferred stock and related surplus), divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: Short-Term Debt / Equity Capital
entries.definition: Commercial paper and borrowings with a remaining maturity of one year or less divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: Current Portion of Long-Term Debt / Equity Capital
entries.definition: Amount of borrowings included in other borrowed funds with a remaining maturity of less than one year, and subordinated notes and debentures that are scheduled to mature within one year divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: Excess of Cost over Fair Value / Equity Capital
entries.definition: The sum of goodwill and other intangible assets included in equity investments in bank subsidiaries and associated banks, in nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies, and in subsidiary holding companies divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: Long-Term Debt / Consolidated Long-Term Debt
entries.definition: Parent company long-term debt (the sum of other borrowed funds with a remaining maturity of greater than one year), and subordinated notes and debentures (including limited-life preferred stock and related surplus) divided by consolidated long-term debt. 144 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Equity Investment in Subsidiaries / Equity Capital
entries.definition: Equity investment in bank subsidiaries and associated banks, in nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbanks, and in subsidiary holding companies divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: Total Investment in Subsidiaries / Equity Capital
entries.definition: Total investments in and receivables due from subsidiaries and associated companies divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: Equity Investment in Subsidiaries / Consolidated Equity Capital Plus Qualifying Trust Preferred Securities Plus Other Preferred Stock Eligible for Tier 1 Capital
entries.basis: Consolidated Equity Capital Plus Qualifying Trust Preferred Securities Plus Other Preferred Stock Eligible for Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: Equity investment in bank subsidiaries and associated banks, in nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbanks, and in subsidiary holding companies divided by the sum of consolidated equity capital, other cumulative and noncumulative preferred stock eligible for inclusion in tier 1 capital, and qualifying trust preferred securities.

entries.label: Total Investment in Subsidiaries / Consolidated Equity Capital Plus Qualifying Trust Preferred Securities Plus Other Preferred Stock Eligible for Tier 1 Capital
entries.basis: Consolidated Equity Capital Plus Qualifying Trust Preferred Securities Plus Other Preferred Stock Eligible for Tier 1 Capital
entries.definition: Total investments in and receivables due from subsidiaries and associated companies divided by the sum of consolidated equity capital, other cumulative and noncumulative preferred stock eligible for inclusion in tier 1 capital, and qualifying trust preferred securities.

entries.label: Equity Investment in Subsidiaries Less Equity Capital / Net Income (X)
entries.definition: The difference between equity investment in bank subsidiaries and associated banks, in nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbanks, and in subsidiary holding companies and parent company equity capital divided by parent company net income. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Equity Investment in Subsidiaries Less Equity Capital / Net Income Less Dividends (X)
entries.definition: The difference between equity investment in bank subsidiaries and associated banks, in nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbanks, and in subsidiary holding companies and parent company equity capital divided by the difference between parent company net income and cash dividends declared. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Operating Income Less Taxes Plus Noncash Items / Operating Expense Plus Dividends
entries.definition: Total operating income minus applicable income taxes (or plus tax benefit) plus noncash items included in operating expense divided by the sum of total operating expense and dividends declared.

entries.label: Cash Flow from Operations Plus Noncash Items Plus Operating Expense / Operating Expense Plus Dividends
entries.definition: The sum of cash flow provided by operating activities, total operating expense, and noncash items included in operating expense divided by the sum of total operating expense and cash dividends declared.

entries.label: Adjusted Cash Flow / Operating Expense Plus Repaid Long-Term Debt Plus Dividends
entries.basis: Operating Expense Plus Repaid Long-Term Debt Plus Dividends
entries.definition: The sum of total cash flow (from operating, financing, and investing activities), operating expense, non-cash items included in operating expense, repaid long-term debt, and cash dividends declared divided by the sum of operating expenses, repaid long-term debt, and cash dividends declared.

entries.label: Pretax Operating Income Plus Interest Expense / Interest Expense
entries.definition: Income before taxes plus interest expense divided by interest expense.

entries.label: Pretax Operating Income Plus Interest Expense and Trust Preferred Interest Expense / Interest Expense Plus Trust Preferred Interest Expense
entries.basis: Interest Expense Plus Trust Preferred Interest Expense
entries.definition: Parent company pretax income plus parent company interest expense and interest expense paid to special purpose subsidiaries that have issued trust preferred securities divided by parent company interest expense plus interest expense paid to special purpose subsidiaries that have issued trust preferred securities.

entries.label: Dividends Plus Interest from Subsidiaries / Interest Expense Plus Dividends
entries.definition: Dividend and interest income from bank, nonbank, and holding company subsidiaries divided by the sum of interest expense and cash dividends declared.

entries.label: Fees Plus Other Income from Subsidiaries / Salaries Plus Other Expenses
entries.definition: Management and service fees and other income from bank, nonbank, and holding company subsidiaries divided by salaries and employee benefits and other expenses.

entries.label: Net Income / Current Portion of Long-Term Debt Plus Preferred Dividends (X)
entries.definition: Parent company net income divided by the sum of long-term debt that matures within one year and dividends declared on perpetual preferred and limited-life preferred stock. (This ratio is not expressed as a percent and is, therefore, not multiplied by 100.)

entries.label: Net Assets That Reprice in 1 Year / Total Assets
entries.definition: The difference between current assets and the sum of short-term debt, long-term debt, and other debt that reprices within one year divided by total parent company assets.

entries.label: Past Due and Nonaccrual Loans and Leases as Percent of Total Loans and Leases
90 Days and Over Past Due
entries.definition: Loans and leases that are 90 days and over past due divided by parent company loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Nonaccrual
entries.definition: Loans and leases that are in nonaccrual status divided by parent company loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Total
entries.definition: The sum of loans and leases that are 90 days or more past due and loans and leases that are in nonaccrual status divided by parent company loans and leases, net of unearned income.

entries.label: Guaranteed Loans as a Percentage of Equity Capital
To Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Guaranteed loans to bank subsidiaries divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: To Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Guaranteed loans to nonbank subsidiaries divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: To Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: Guaranteed loans to subsidiary holding companies divided by parent company equity capital. 146 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Total
entries.definition: Total guaranteed loans to bank, nonbank, and holding company subsidiaries divided by parent company equity capital.

entries.label: As a Percentage of Consolidated Holding Company Assets
Nonbank Assets of Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.basis: Percent of Consolidated Holding Company Assets
entries.definition: Total combined nonbank assets of nonbank subsidiaries and their majority-owned direct and indirect subsidiaries divided by consolidated assets of the holding company.

entries.label: Combined Thrift Assets
entries.definition: Total combined assets of federal savings associations, federal savings banks, and thrift subsidiaries divided by consolidated assets of the holding company.

entries.label: Combined Foreign Nonbank Subsidiary Assets
entries.basis: Percent of Consolidated Holding Company Assets
entries.definition: Total combined foreign nonbank subsidiary assets divided by consolidated assets of the holding company. entries.label: Dividends Declared / Income before Undistributed Income
entries.definition: Consolidated cash dividends declared divided by parent income before undistributed income of subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Dividends Declared / Net Income
entries.definition: Consolidated cash dividends declared divided by parent company net income.

entries.label: Net Income Less Dividends / Average Equity Capital
entries.definition: The difference between parent net income and consolidated cash dividends declared divided by consolidated (four-point) average equity capital. (See Average Balances in section 2.)

entries.label: Dividends from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Parent company dividend income from bank subsidiaries divided by consolidated cash dividends declared.

entries.label: Dividends from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Parent company dividend income from nonbank subsidiaries divided by consolidated cash dividends declared.

entries.label: Dividends from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: Parent company dividend income from subsidiary holding companies divided by consolidated cash dividends declared.

entries.label: Dividends from All Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Parent company dividend income from by bank, nonbank, and holding company subsidiaries divided by consolidated cash dividends declared.

entries.label: Dividends from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Dividend income from bank subsidiaries divided by the sum of dividends from bank subsidiaries and equity in the undistributed income of bank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Interest Income from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Interest income from bank subsidiaries divided by the sum of dividends from bank subsidiaries and equity in the undistributed income of bank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Management and service fees from bank subsidiaries divided by the sum of dividends from bank subsidiaries and equity in undistributed income of bank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Other Income from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Other income from bank subsidiaries divided by the sum of dividends from bank subsidiaries and equity in undistributed income of bank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Operating Income from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Total income from bank subsidiaries and associated banks, excluding equity in undistributed income, divided by the sum of dividend income from bank subsidiaries and equity in undistributed income of bank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Dividends from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Dividend income from nonbank subsidiaries divided by the sum of dividends from nonbank subsidiaries and equity in undistributed income of nonbank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Interest Income from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Interest income from nonbank subsidiaries divided by the sum of dividends from nonbank subsidiaries and equity in undistributed income of nonbank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Management and service fees from nonbank subsidiaries divided by the sum of dividends from nonbank subsidiaries and equity in undistributed income of nonbank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Other Income from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Other income from nonbank subsidiaries divided by the sum of dividends from nonbank subsidiaries and equity in undistributed income of nonbank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Operating Income from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Total income from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies, excluding equity in undistributed income, divided by the sum of dividends from nonbank subsidiaries and equity in undistributed income of nonbank subsidiaries and associated companies.

entries.label: Percent of Subsidiary Holding Companies’ Net Income
Dividends from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.basis: Percent of Subsidiary Holding Companies’ Net Income
entries.definition: Dividend income from subsidiary holding companies divided by the sum of dividends from subsidiary holding companies and equity in undistributed income of subsidiary holding companies. 150 A User’s Guide for the Bank Holding Company Performance Report

entries.label: Interest Income from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.basis: Percent of Subsidiary Holding Companies’ Net Income
entries.definition: Interest income from subsidiary holding companies divided by the sum of dividends from subsidiary holding companies and equity in undistributed income of subsidiary holding companies.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.basis: Percent of Subsidiary Holding Companies’ Net Income
entries.definition: Management and service fees from subsidiary holding companies divided by the sum of dividends from subsidiary holding companies and equity in undistributed income of subsidiary holding companies.

entries.label: Other Income from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.basis: Percent of Subsidiary Holding Companies’ Net Income
entries.definition: Other income from subsidiary holding companies divided by the sum of dividends from subsidiary holding companies and equity in undistributed income of subsidiary holding companies.

entries.label: Operating Income from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.basis: Percent of Subsidiary Holding Companies’ Net Income
entries.definition: Total income from subsidiary holding companies, excluding equity in undistributed income, divided by the sum of dividends from subsidiary holding companies and equity in undistributed income of subsidiary holding companies.

entries.label: Dividends from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Dividend income from bank subsidiaries and associated banks divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Interest Income from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Interest income from bank subsidiaries and associated banks divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Management and service fees from bank subsidiaries and associated banks divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Other Income from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Other income from bank subsidiaries and associated banks divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Operating Income from Bank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Total income from bank subsidiaries and associated banks, excluding equity in undistributed income, divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Dividends from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Dividend income from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Interest Income from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Interest income from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Management and service fees from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Other Income from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Other income from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Operating Income from Nonbank Subsidiaries
entries.definition: Total income from nonbank subsidiaries and associated nonbank companies, excluding equity in undistributed income, divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Dividends from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: Dividend income from subsidiary holding companies divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Interest Income from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: Interest income from subsidiary holding companies divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Management and Service Fees from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: Management and service fees from subsidiary holding companies divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Other Income from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: Other income from subsidiary holding companies divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Operating Income from Subsidiary Holding Companies
entries.definition: Total income from subsidiary holding companies, excluding equity in undistributed income, divided by parent company total operating income.

entries.label: Loans and Advances from Subsidiaries / Short-Term Debt
entries.definition: Loans and advances from bank, nonbank, and holding company subsidiaries divided by borrowings with a remaining maturity of one year or less (commercial paper and other borrowings).
